And people like you, Peter, can help deliver a win. name: Jake Duesenberg
subject: Massive Win for the Grassroots
body:
| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=massive_win_for_the_grassroots&n=1)
---
Peter \-- The Establishment thought they could take advantage of you. Insider candidates for Minnesota Governor spent hundreds of thousands of dollars in an attempt to steal the Republican Endorsement on Saturday. They campaigned on moderate policies and their insider connections. They faked being "grassroots" or being the "outsider candidate." **Thanks to hundreds of grassroots patriots like you, their political careers were promptly ended. Conservative grassroots activists didn't buy what they were selling!** RINO Senator Paul Gazelka came in dead last on the first ballot, eventually dropping out and throwing his support behind Kendall Qualls – the Establishment's choice for Governor. Kendall Qualls paid a **HUGE political price** by speaking out against the Never Again Bill. He campaigned on allowing a Governor to have Unilateral Powers for 30 days. Qualls, Gazelka, and others thought they could win by ignoring Action 4 Liberty supporters. They were dead wrong. Many of you called, texted and emailed Kendall about his awful stance. And it appears that pressure had an impact. He admitted that he was being **"hammered" by people** because of his stance (42:50 timestamp). [](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=w5XKTZ0h8dEcNEoc_HghfKjnpatMi4vZvGlxm2Y6MDzHh4OwAp7bReJDXOMqV0FljApyB11UA_9soR3eKni9li-HR2C6mXG1w0P7T4oJK3Y&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=massive_win_for_the_grassroots&n=2) **Both Mayor Mike Murphy and Dr Neil Shah had a combined third of the Republican delegation supporting their campaigns. Although they didn't prevail in winning the endorsement, they inspired a huge army of awesome activists.** The eventual winner was Dr Scott Jensen. Although Scott had a bad voting record as Senator, he definitely ran a grassroots, outsider campaign. And he eventually won over the delegates when it came down to him and the Insider's candidate, Kendall. Let this be a lesson to candidates everywhere: **There is no path to victory in the Republican Party without the grassroots this election cycle.** The Establishment was only overwhelmed because Action 4 Liberty initiated a massive “Go-Out-To-Caucus” Campaign in February. THOUSANDS of patriotic Minnesotans showed up and were elected delegates. We trained some of these delegates at our headquarters in Roseville – many of which played a key role in standing up for conservative principles. This convention will go down as a turning point within the conservative movement. Politicians no longer run the show – YOU DO! As you may know, there is still a lot of work to do. Republican Party Leadership is seething with rage because of our caucus efforts. Dave Hann, the chairman of the GOP, dedicated his opening convention speech to his disdain for Action 4 Liberty supporters. **Rest assured, Hann will soon be in the minority of leaders standing against grassroots conservatives like you. Our organization efforts are unmatched, and are only beneficial to the conservative movement.** Hann may not know it yet, but the tides are turning in favor of Liberty-Minded Republicans in the State of Minnesota. **Jake Duesenberg** **President, Action 4 Liberty** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=massive_win_for_the_grassroots&n=3 "Support Us") [Support Us](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=massive_win_for_the_grassroots&n=3)
---
Action 4 Liberty
1920 Oakcrest Ave #5
Roseville, MN 55113
Action 4 Liberty · United States

You can also keep up with Jake Duesenberg on [Facebook](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6nyVoJL5zCIi1gu8lCoYmQrA8P7rhuOjJmdy-IRmglie&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=massive_win_for_the_grassroots&n=5).

body:
| **A _n email went out earlier that incorrectly said we were holding a call with Rep. Rashida Tlaib tonight. Unlike corporate Democrats, we admit when we make a mistake. _** **_That call with Rep. Tlaib happened last week, and on the call, she warned all of us about big money corporate interests unleashing attacks on progressives._**

****_To find out more about some of those great progressive candidates, please read this week's newsletter below!

_★ ★ ★ _

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=11&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)
_
Join us next Monday, May 23rd, at **8:30p ET** /7:30 CT for our **National ‘Organize-to-Win’ Call** with Our Revolution Board Member and Minnesota Attorney General **Keith Ellison** on the state of the progressive fight in 2022!

These bi-weekly meetings are key to building our movement, so be sure to mark your calendar!

[RSVP HERE](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/340?t=12&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)
**** | Insider News from the Political Revolution!

* * *
**HEADLINES: Bernie’s Senate Fight for M4A | Rashida vs. Dark Money | Fort for Congress in GA | Reject the Recall in SF | Palmer for DC Council | Attica Scott Rally in KY | Election Day in NC | Pro-Choice Actions | Levin & House Labor | Ellison on Student Debt | & MORE!**

★ ★ ★

**WAGING THE FIGHT FOR MEDICARE FOR ALL IN THE SENATE AND BEYOND**

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=13&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

**Our Revolution** members rallied at the Capitol Thursday with Bernie, who as Budget Committee Chairman held the first-ever Senate hearing on **Medicare for All** and reintroduced the bill!

**This is how we wage the fight** , and our movement showed up to show our strength and make the demand — needed more than ever as 1 million Americans have died in the pandemic.

“This is an issue not just of healthcare but of what kind of nation _we are_ ,” Bernie said. “**Medicare for All will become the law of the land — if not now, in the future — because this is what the American people want**.”

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=14&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

Bernie welcomed doctors and nurses to testify before the committee and make the case for a Medicare for All single-payer system. He emphasized that it would **save $650B a year** over our current dysfunctional system.

“In our corrupt political system, the private healthcare sector has spent more than $10.6B on lobbying and $1.7B on campaign contributions to maintain the status quo,” Bernie wrote in an op-ed in [Fox](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5516?t=15&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO). “**They own many of the politicians in both the Democratic and Republican parties**.”

Later that same evening, he [rallied](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5517?t=16&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO) with Our Revolution-endorsed **Summer Lee** for her run for Congress in PA-12! “We need a strong progressive like Summer in Congress, we need to tell these billionaires we won’t allow them to buy our elections and control our democracy.”

★ ★ ★

[Become a RECURRING DONOR to Our Revolution right now to fund critical action campaigns to defend our rights and communities against the far right of both parties. Our movement must stand united in the fight for Medicare for All, climate action, reproductive freedom and so much more.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/or-newsletter-22&amount=10&refcode=OR_EM_NEWS_1MO_20220514_1_1&recurring=true?t=17&refcode2=2914_5885482_ockKVO&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

★ ★ ★

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=18&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

★ ★ ★

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=19&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

**Our Revolution** is committed to re-electing US Rep. **Rashida Tlaib** to her third term representing Michigan’s 13th District in Congress!

AIPAC and right-wing money is pouring in against her, but **Rashida knows the power of grassroots organizing** that helped her beat the forces of the establishment in 2018.

“With your help and people-power on the ground, we’ll do it again,” she told our members. “**We’ll outwork the hate, the lies, the gaslighting**. I refuse to sell out and when they can’t control you, they’ll do anything.”

“They profit off of our broken systems, they want the status quo while our residents struggle. **We need a Congress of working-class folks with lived experiences** ,” Rashida stated. “It is corporate greed which is, in many ways, killing our people.”

“On a [Monday evening call](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5518?t=20&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO) hosted by **Our Revolution** , Rep. **Rashida Tlaib** (...) told supporters Democrats must elect more lawmakers who support abortion rights to Congress in the midterms,” [Politico](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5519?t=21&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO) reported.

“**Everything is calling us to bold action** — our right to reproductive freedom and privacy could be pulled out from under us,” she said. “The movement on the ground is real and we must use that pressure.”

[Become a sustaining member of Our Revolution to help re-elect Rashida and grow our power inside and outside of Congress!](http://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4893?t=22&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

★ ★ ★

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=23&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

**VINCENT FORT FOR CONGRESS**

**Our Revolution** joins Bernie and Killer Mike in the fight to elect Sen. **Vincent Fort** to US Congress in GA-13!

Vincent is taking on the right-wing Democratic incumbent, and this is a huge opportunity to swing another blue district for the working class. **Early voting has started — Election Day is May 24**.

“With a strong field operation, **we can kick out this Blue Dog** , elect a progressive, and send shockwaves across the country,” Vincent told us on our [Monday Night Call](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5518?t=24&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO). “When we talk to people, they run from David Scott in droves and **turn to our progressive, proactive, community-based politics**.”

Vincent’s top priorities include Medicare for All, a living wage, the Green New Deal, and free college and apprenticeships. “I’ve been an educator and a State Senator, but **first and foremost I’m an activist** — and that’s how I legislate,” he said.

Vincent grew up in a union household and became a professor of African-American History. He served in the Georgia Senate for 20 years, where **he passed major reforms for public education and the first hate crimes anti-predatory lending legislation**.

★ ★ ★

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=25&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

**REJECT THE RECALL IN SF**

**Our Revolution** stands with San Francisco District Attorney **Chesa Boudin** against a vicious right-wing recall attempt — Prop H. Chesa is one of our country’s great criminal justice reformers, and he joined our [National Organizing Call](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5518?t=26&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO) Monday night.

Chesa promised three things during his run for DA:
1. Fight mass incarceration
2. Increase victim advocacy services
3. Enforce the law equally — billionaires & corporations included

He’s delivering, and now right-wing powers are scrambling to get rid of him. “If you support this recall, you’re joining sides with Republicans, billionaires, Ted Cruz, Tucker Carlson,” Chesa said. “**They’re taking features of the failed tough-on-crime approach and trying to blame those on me**.”

Chesa is right. It’s taken decades to build up a terrible system, and we need him to continue his work to fix it. “We’re creating a worker protection unit to prosecute companies for wage theft, ending cash bail, expanding drug and mental health programs,” he reported.

“**This is about building safety now and in the long run** ,” Chesa said. “Vote NO on the death penalty, NO on police violence and impunity, NO on using sexual survivors' DNA against them, **Vote NO on Proposition H**.”

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=27&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

Chesa is part of Our Revolution’s endorsed **California 2022 Slate** , which includes State Assembly candidates **Jennifer Esteen** (D-20), **James Coleman** (D-22), **Fatima Iqbal-Zubair** (D-65), and **Alex Lee** for re-election to District 24.

Also on the slate are two candidates for District Attorney **Pamela Price** For Alameda County and **Alana Mathews** for Sacramento County, and **Dave Myers** for San Diego County Sheriff.

**Ballots should start arriving this week and election day is June 28th!** [Join Our Revolution to help power our endorsed slate to victory!](http://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4893?t=28&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

★ ★ ★

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=29&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

**PALMER FOR DC COUNCIL**

**Our Revolution** is proud to endorse working mom and true progressive **Erin Palmer** for DC Council Chairwoman!

Erin is a grassroots leader taking on a corporate-funded incumbent who puts the interests of gambling bosses and big developers ahead of DC residents and locally-owned businesses.

"**Housing is a human right**. It’s a values statement, but it's also rooted in personal experience,” she said on our [Monday Night Call](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5518?t=30&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO). “I have a family member who died while homeless. I'm running for DC Council because **every person is entitled to safe, secure, and affordable housing**."

Erin has deep roots in the community and has served in critical local positions closest to the people and the problems. She knows the solutions residents need, and we need to make sure she gets elected!

[Sign up to volunteer to make calls to help Erin and our other endorsed progressive champions take power up and down the ballot!](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=31&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

★ ★ ★

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=32&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

**ATTICA SCOTT EARLY VOTE KICK-OFF**

**Our Revolution** kicked off early voting in Kentucky on Thursday with a rally for **Attica Scott** at the Mammoth Art Space in Louisville, followed by a canvass where we knocked on doors to get out the vote!

**Election Day is Tuesday** and Attica is the progressive choice to represent Kentucky’s 3rd District in Congress.

“We are working to change the face of Kentucky politics, and we’ve got to organize,” Attica said. “**A shift is happening all over our country, and now is the time to choose bold leadership over complacency**.”

Attica has a long history of leadership and activism in Louisville, defeating a 34-year incumbent in 2016 to be the first Black woman elected to the Kentucky General Assembly this century. Attica fought for the **Green New Deal** at the State House and **raised the minimum wage** on Louisville Metro Council.

[Become a member of Our Revolution TODAY to fund our on-the-ground field operations for candidates like Attica around the country this primary season!](http://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4893?t=33&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

★ ★ ★

**NC VOTES TUESDAY!**
2 POWERFUL PROGRESSIVES ON THE BALLOT

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=34&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

Tuesday is Election Day in North Carolina, and Our Revolution has two powerful progressive allies running for Congress — **Erica Smith** and **Nida Allam**!

Both are dedicated partners to our movement and would be strong voices in Washington for Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, the PRO Act, and more.

State Sen. Erica Smith is running on a Rural New Deal in NC’s 1st District. “**Our communities deserve more than a GoFundMe healthcare system and a Dollar Store economy** ,” Erica said.

Nida Allam was the first Muslim woman ever elected to public office in the state, now running in NC’s 4th District. She’s an outspoken progressive who served as a **political director for Bernie’s 2016 presidential campaign**.

Bringing home these wins would make a huge statement for our movement in the South and across the country. [Sign up to VOLUNTEER to give these allies a huge push going into Election Day!](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=35&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

★ ★ ★

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=36&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

**VOLUNTEER FLIPPING VOTERS FOR ERICA SMITH**

**Our Revolution Phonebank Force** activist **Taylor Pinckney** shared her volunteer experience with us last week of turning a voter from a corporatist Democrat to people’s champion **Erica Smith** for Congress in NC-1.

Taylor was thrilled to hear how grateful the voter was to learn he had a progressive option on the ballot in North Carolina — which he learned from her phone call and an Our Revolution mailer.

“He thanked us for opening his eyes that **Erica Smith** was the most progressive candidate and said that’s what his district needs,” Taylor relayed. “**It was cool to see the impact in real-time — when I make these connections with voters, it motivates me to keep the work going**.”

**Our candidates rely wholly on the power of the movement — which means we need as many volunteers as possible** to help lift the voice of working people and drown out the big money.

[Making calls is easy and fun, and you can earn rewards along the way. JOIN THE PHONE BANK FORCE](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=37&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

★ ★ ★

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=38&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

★ ★ ★

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=39&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

**TAKE ACTION FOR REPRODUCTIVE JUSTICE**

The far-right is laser-focused on dismantling reproductive and privacy rights in America, and right-wing Democrats like Joe Manchin helped kill a vote last week to codify **Roe v. Wade** , proving why we must fight against the right-wing in both parties.

**Our Revolution** is working hard to elect pro-choice candidates like **Jessica Cisneros** vs. anti-choice Dems like **Henry Cuellar** — even against the endorsement of Nancy Pelosi — all while **ramping up our activism to make our power felt inside _and outside_ the halls of power**.

**Our Revolution** has been in rapid response since the Supreme Court leak, organizing actions and events around the country with allies like **Ultra Violet** and **Planned Parenthood**.

Now, we’re scaling up our impact and launching an [action page](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5520?t=40&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO) where you can sign up to host your own demonstration! We can send you t-shirts, printable signs, assist with turnout, and more. **The majority must be heard on reproductive rights!**

[HOST OR JOIN AN ACTION NEAR YOU!](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5520?t=41&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

★ ★ ★

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=42&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

**ANDY LEVIN AIDS HOUSE LABOR WIN**

**Our Revolution** -endorsed US Rep. **Andy Levin** worked with House staffers on a Resolution that passed this week, giving them the right to form a union, [The Washington Post](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5521?t=43&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO) reports.

“I could not be prouder of the members of the **Congressional Workers Union** and their organizing force. I offer my solidarity and full support as they begin to organize their workplaces in the coming weeks,” Andy said.

**CWU won because they organized** and mounted public pressure on Dem leadership to hold the vote. And, Speaker Pelosi announced a $45k/year minimum annual pay (up from $25k/year, an absurdly unlivable wage in D.C.).

Hopefully, this will put pressure on the 10 Republicans who would have to vote for a similar resolution for staffers in the Senate to be able to unionize. “**Workers, we’ll see you in the Senate** ,” Andy said.

Andy is one of our best in Congress, and **Our Revolution** is going all-out to make sure he’s re-elected in Michigan-11 against corporate Dem Haley Stevens.

[Become a sustaining member of Our Revolution to help us build worker power and help working-class champions like Andy beat the establishment.](http://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4893?t=44&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

★ ★ ★

[ ](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5515?t=45&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO)

**PRESSURING BIDEN TO CANCEL STUDENT DEBT**

Our Revolution Board Member and Minnesota Attorney General **Keith Ellison** is organizing pressure on President Biden to eliminate “the crushing burden of $1.7 trillion in federal student loan debt.”

Keith joined state attorneys general from New York, Hawaii, Illinois, Michigan, New Mexico, Washington, and Puerto Rico to [urge Biden](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5522?t=46&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO) to use his power to cancel the debt, [MSN](https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/5523?t=47&akid=2914%2E5885482%2EockKVO) reports.

These bi-weekly meetings are key to building our movement, so be sure to mark your calendar! ★ ★ ★ PHONEBANK TO FIGHT BACK AGAINST BIG MONEY “They have money, but we have the people! ” Bernie said on Thursday speaking about the dark money targeting progressive candidates in races around the country. AIPAC spending figures : $1.2M for Henry Cuellar against Jessica Cisneros (TX-28), $2.3M for Steven Irwin against Summer Lee (PA-12), $2.3M for Don Davis against Erica Smith (NC-1), and $2M for Valerie Foushee against Nida Allam (NC-4). We can overcome these insidious financial forces, but our movement must coalesce and rise up as a unified front. If we each do what we can and commit ourselves to this collective project, we can outmatch corporate power. One way to exert our people-power is through — and we have several happening now — where you can talk to voters directly and circumvent the dark money ads slandering our movement. Money can’t win if we turn out the vote! Help us make calls any day of the week for Our Revolution partners like Alexi Giannoulias for Illinois Secretary of State, and congressional candidates Junaid Ahmed (IL-8), Mike Ortega (CA-46), Andy Levin (MI-11), Brittany Ramos DeBarros (NY-11), and David Segal (RI-2). ★ ★ ★ This week, we’re ramping up calls to elect Amy Vilela to Congress. She is a progressive champion who is a powerful Medicare for All ally. ★ ★ ★ Help us defend democracy by electing progressive Secretary of State candidate Alexi Giannoulias in Illinois! ★ ★ ★ Sign up for phone banking as we organize to elect progressive Democrat and Our Revolution member and endorsed candidate David Segal to Congress. We will be calling thousands of Our Revolution supporters in Rhode Island’s First Congressional District, which includes much of the city of Providence. ★ ★ ★ Sign up for phone banking as we organize to re-elect progressive Democrats and Our Revolution endorsed Rep. Andy Levin to Congress. We will be calling thousands of Our Revolution supporters in Michigan’s 11th congressional district, which includes Detroit area communities such as Bloomfield and Pontiac. ★ ★ ★ Are you a member of Our Revolution? For $5 a month , you’ll be part of choosing our candidate endorsements and crafting our platform and strategy. Plus, we’ll send you our new 2022 Membership Card. To show our gratitude to members joining at higher donation levels, we’re sweetening the deal! For $10 a month , get a sticker 6-pack , and at $15 , get the stickers and a poster. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: We’re humbly asking for your help to elect Jess, Summer, and Nida
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220516-3031-header&t=1&akid=3031%2E2526796%2Et2Bwj2)
From day one of this campaign, our movement has fought to uplift the needs and lived experiences of working people. While we’ve been able to make progress forward, there is still so much we need to do.
We need a bigger squad in Congress who understand the realities of working people — who have lived the struggle themselves and who are dedicated to fighting for justice for ALL of us.
**Jessica Cisneros, Summer Lee, and Nida Allam are these leaders and they have the chance to join Alexandria in Congress.** With your support, they can be the next stage of progressive victories in the U.S. They will fight for the transformative change that working people deserve, and that’s why we’re asking you today to join us in supporting them before their elections on May 17 and May 24.
**We wouldn’t be asking if it weren’t important.** [If you're able to, please split a $9 donation – or whatever you can – to help power Summer Lee, Jessica Cisneros, and Nida Allam to victory and build our progressive coalition in Congress.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220516?refcode=em20220516-3031-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=3031_2526796_t2Bwj2&akid=3031%2E2526796%2Et2Bwj2)
**[Contribute $9](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220516?refcode=em20220516-3031-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&refcode2=3031_2526796_t2Bwj2&akid=3031%2E2526796%2Et2Bwj2)**
Over the last five years, our progressive movement has toppled political regimes in St. Louis, Detroit, Minneapolis, Boston, New York, and beyond – electing visionary leaders like Cori Bush, Rashida Tlaib, Ilhan Omar, Ayanna Pressley, and Jamaal Bowman (just to name a few).
We know that our agenda is popular from urban to rural communities – because healthcare for all, environmental justice, and livable wages are for _everyone, everywhere_ , not just people in big cities.
Here’s where they are running:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220516?refcode=em20220516-3031-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&refcode2=3031_2526796_t2Bwj2&akid=3031%2E2526796%2Et2Bwj2)
There’s so much to highlight about each of them, but to give you a snapshot:
**Summer Lee** was the first Black woman from Western Pennsylvania ever elected to the state legislature. When Summer first ran for State House in 2018, she took on a 20-year incumbent, doubled voter turnout, and won. She’s a dedicated organizer, activist, and attorney who supports workers rights, Medicare for All, and a Green New Deal. With longtime Democrat Mike Doyle retiring, Summer is running to bring her progressive vision to Pennsylvania’s 12th district.
If elected, **Nida Alam** will be the youngest woman ever elected to Congress at just 28 years old, and the first Pakistani-American member. Nida is running in North Carolina’s open 4th district seat.
In 2020, Nida ran an unprecedented progressive campaign for Durham County Commissioner, where she became the first Muslim woman elected to public office in North Carolina and where she fought to raise the minimum wage and provide property tax relief for low-income people. Now she is ready to fight for a progressive agenda in Congress.
**Jessica Cisneros** was born and raised in Laredo, Texas, right on the border. Her parents immigrated to Texas to start a new home for her family. Jessica wanted to be part of solving the problems she saw up close – so she became an immigration and human rights attorney.
Jessica is running against Henry Cuellar, the last anti-abortion “Democrat” in the House who (prior to being challenged by Jessica) voted almost 70% of the time with Donald Trump.
Last cycle, Jessica was massively outspent, but only lost by about 2,700 votes – a gap that can easily be closed with your support. So it’s up to us to ensure Jessica gets the surge of grassroots donations she needs today to win the runoff election coming up on May 24.
None of these candidates are taking a dime of corporate PAC money. Just like Alexandria’s, their campaigns are powered by the people.
[Will you make a contribution to elect Nina, Summer, and Jessica to Congress? 100% of your donation will go directly to their campaigns so they can organize and get their progressive message out before the primaries.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220516?refcode=em20220516-3031-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&refcode2=3031_2526796_t2Bwj2&akid=3031%2E2526796%2Et2Bwj2)
We’re so grateful to all of you and for your willingness to give $5, $15, $50 at a time to make incredible things possible. We’ve beat the odds before, and together we can do it again.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220516?refcode=em20220516-3031-P_FND_ANO_END&t=24&refcode2=3031_2526796_t2Bwj2&akid=3031%2E2526796%2Et2Bwj2)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20220516-3031-P_FND_ANO_END&t=25&akid=3031%2E2526796%2Et2Bwj2)**
---|---
[](https://www.facebook.com/OcasioCortez/?t=26&akid=3031%2E2526796%2Et2Bwj2) | [](https://twitter.com/AOC?t=27&akid=3031%2E2526796%2Et2Bwj2) | [](https://www.instagram.com/aoc/?t=28&akid=3031%2E2526796%2Et2Bwj2)
---|---|---
Email us: [speak@ocasiocortez.com](mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com)
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, PO Box 680080, Corona, NY 11368.

Friends of Karina,

Brian

clean_body: We are laser focused on changing this state for the better and continue to take our conservative message across the state. I continue to lay out my po| | | | | Note from Mark | | | The time to vote is here! Early voting at your county clerk’s office and absentee voting has begun. Expanded early voting at satellite offices will begin Saturday, May 21st. Soon, you can visit our website and find a polling location near you. Primary Election Day is Tuesday, June 7th! I humbly ask for your vote to be the Republican nominee for Governor. New Mexico is on the wrong track thanks to Governor Michelle Lujan Grisham and it’s critical that we defeat her and turn things around. I want to make this state a place that our children are proud to live in, not a place to move away from. I want to revitalize our economy and fight harmful inflation, reform our education system, and make New Mexico safe again. I am the only candidate who can beat MLG in November. But, I need you and your family to show up and VOTE! | | | | | In the News KOB 4 just released some BIG news in the race for New Mexico Governor! According to the SurveyUSA poll recently conducted,Mark has a 32 point lead over his next closest competitor in the Republican Primary. This poll is great news! Recent polls also show us neck-and-neck with Governor Grisham at 46%-46%. And her recent approval ratinings have dipped to less than 50%. “Ronchetti embraces outsider label in GOP primary” ABQ Journal The Albuquerque Journal sat down with Mark for a candidate profile piece. You can read more about Mark’s background, where he stands on certain issues, and why he got in the race . Have you seen our latest TV Ads? “We’re all paying the price for radical policies,” Ronchetti explains while filling up at the pump. As of today, the average cost of gasoline in New Mexico is $4.28 per gallon. New Mexicans are struggling with inflation at the pump which are the result of ultra-liberal policies. - . | | | Field Update | | | | | | | | | What can we say? We love traveling this great state and meeting with folks from every county! We had a great time recently with our friends in San Juan County where Mark was honored to receive San Juan County Commissioner Steve Lanier’s endorsement. | | **Make Oregon Great Again: Kerry McQuisten for Governor
by Michael Yon** _14 May 2022
Panama City, Panama
Mind Dump, Sans Edit_ Smooth seas never made a successful sailor. But when ship Captains all from the same academy constantly crash perfect ships during perfect weather, it’s not the weather, or the ships. It’s the academy that draws and creates these morons. You already know and suffer from the Blue academy that created crackhead Hunter Biden, Psaki, Harris, Pelosi, ANTIFA and BLM murders and arson, baby formula shortages, while pushing another 40 billion dollars into a Democrat created war between Russia and United States that will end in the starvation deaths of potentially hundreds of millions of people globally. The biggest famines in all human history are unfolding. All this created from thin air from the same Blue power-addicts who turned Seattle, Portland, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and many other cities, into drug-stupor hells. Blue team created this. During perfect weather. While operating excellent ships created by Conservatives before them. Blue team crashed them all. Then raised taxes to burn on the needle-strewn beaches. Have you been to Portland in recent times? I have. Plenty. The place is a shit hole. I first visited Portland when I was a young Green Beret. Portland was a dream town. I was there last year. Many hotels filled with drug addicts at taxpayer expense. We get what we accept. San Francisco is filthy, dangerous, corrupt. Feels completely unsafe and rich-uncivilized. Street-shitters galore. Distinct lack of children. Places feel terrible without lots of children. All happy places have children running around. You can’t have children running around those animals. I literally am safer in malarial Darien Gap than in Portland or blue hells of DC or Atlanta, or Philadelphia. Have you been to any of those shitholes lately? I have. And a lot more. I’ve also been all over Darien Gap jungles where the children roll in the mud and constantly swim in the rivers and they are safe and incredibly happy. Always screaming and laughing jumping off those mud cliffs, waving as they fall to the river. Their parents are not drug addicts. Their parents live together. In America, all this happened during GOOD TIMES. All this happened during smooth seas in modern excellent ships. Those days are over. We are on the edge of something nobody reading this ever has faced unless you were in Mao’s China, the Holodomor, or something along those lines. The Great Depression that many of our Grandparents experienced, and from which experience we benefited due to their natural life-long prepping after that experience, was nothing compared to what is about to hit America, and the globe. In Oregon, those purple-headed dope-smokers laying on their couches spewing their smoke filled wisdom must be kicked out, locked out, banished. They no longer are cool. We have no time for nose-ringed ‘leaders.’ Call scum by its proper name. Dope smoking scum created this mess. Anarchy — real anarchy — will soon be upon us. We have no time for ANTIFA or BLM bullshit or mayhem. If the police cannot stop them it’s simply game on. We need leaders. Sane, clean, Americans. The stakes could not be any higher. **Kerry McQuisten is running for Governor of Oregon. I talked with Kerry on the phone last night. She is ultra-MAGA.**(To be clear, I am not ultra-Trump — Trump blows up on the ‘vaccine’ bullshit — but I am super-MAGA). **Kerry McQuisten is very conservative. I spent much of the past 15-hours talking with people about Kerry McQuisten before writing this.** **Oregon — when this storm hits ... you better have a serious Captain on the bridge of that leaking boat. One that will enable law enforcement to go head-to-head against ANTIFA/BLM terrorists, and get those drug addicts off the streets.** **If I were an Oregon Voter, I’d vote for Kerry McQuisten. Heck, given that ALL voting for this is mail-in, I can probably vote 10,000 times from China and Russia.** [https://www.kerrymcquisten.com/](https://KerryMcQuisten.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8a6f5300a53ab781de615e5a1&id=fe718e08a9&e=ae2345792a)

body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our presi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zp3pbda851j3rao65fq4lm15llorfr6iar2qa8m8_rp22sh2s8i66pb2ctge8or4c5h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq9dhkumqb7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65ttgmjjr6tthcjj3fc74e1gm6o3761qjfdbjclj6apbjmarb2clkecr71dpjecrjfkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj33c5jckrreob664qb6oj7m2qmash5u)
This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zirc0nh8qo5rcasb4lb8cnt2b4e4kec8spfrp1h0_rp22sh2s8i66pb2ctge8or4c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. | SOME HELPFUL TIPS ON THE VOTING PROCESS IN THE 10TH
---
| | |
---|---
|
What is "ranked choice voting"?

Simply put, you the voter, will rank your candidate(s) in order of personal preference, from first to last. The winning candidate must garner 50% plus 1 of the vote in order to secure the nomination. If no candidate receives 50% plus 1 after the first round, the candidate with the least votes is eliminated, and voters' second choice selections are distributed among the remaining candidates, and so on each round, until a winner with 50% plus 1 or more votes is declared and becomes the 10th CD's Republican Nominee to challenge and WIN against the left wing progressive Jennifer Wexton.

Strategies to help your favorite candidate(s):

Do's

1) Do limit your vote to one candidate if that's the only one you support. (Voting for down ballot candidates will only dilute your support for your first choice).

2) Do vote for each and every candidate you like (if more than one) as second, third, fourth, etc candidates' votes are counted in each subsequent round(s).

3) Do vote Caleb Max as your 1st Choice and clearly circle your choice.

4) Do bring a PHOTO ID with you.

Do Not

1) Don't rank any one candidate multiple times as this will result in your ballot being discarded.

2) Don't list a candidate(s) on your ballot that you do not support because down ballot rankings grow in significance as candidates are eliminated and subsequent voting round(s) occur.

3) Don't forget to vote.

4) AND please tell us if you have voted. This helps us organize and contact only supporters that may have forgotten that Saturday was the day to vote.

Thank you!

Caleb | SOME HELPFUL TIPS ON THE VOTING PROCESS IN THE 10TH | | | ---|--- | What is "ranked choice voting"? Simply put, you the voter, will rank your candidate(s) in order of personal preference, from first to last. The winning candidate must garner 50% plus 1 of the vote in order to secure the nomination. If no candidate receives 50% plus 1 after the first round, the candidate with the least votes is eliminated, and voters' second choice selections are distributed among the remaining candidates, and so on each round, until a winner with 50% plus 1 or more votes is declared and becomes the 10th CD's Republican Nominee to challenge and WIN against the left wing progressive Jennifer Wexton. Strategies to help your favorite candidate(s): Do's 1) Do limit your vote to one candidate if that's the only one you support. (Voting for down ballot candidates will only dilute your support for your first choice). 2) Do vote for each and every candidate you like (if more than one) as second, third, fourth, etc candidates' votes are counted in each subsequent round(s). 3) Do vote Caleb Max as your 1st Choice and clearly circle your choice. 4) Do bring a PHOTO ID with you. Do Not 1) Don't rank any one candidate multiple times as this will result in your ballot being discarded. 2) Don't list a candidate(s) on your ballot that you do not support because down ballot rankings grow in significance as candidates are eliminated and subsequent voting round(s) occur. 3) Don't forget to vote. 4) AND please tell us if you have voted. This helps us organize and contact only supporters that may have forgotten that Saturday was the day to vote. Thank you! | | | | | == | ---|--- | HOW AND WHERE TO VOTE THIS SATURDAY Scan the Code or == THE BIG DAY FIREHOUSE PRIMARY SATURDAY, MAY 21 9 AM TO 4 PM VOTE FOR CALEB MAX The 10th CD Republican Committee has selected a party run process for selecting our Republican Congressional Candidate to challenge Nancy Pelosi's friend, Democrat Jennifer Wexton. The party canvass, often called a "firehouse or mini- primary" is an extremely simple process. Here is a link on my website about how to vote: == Please show up at the designated voting location in your county (this probably will not be where you normally vote) on May 21st between 9 and 4. You will find the 11 voting locations below and not in Loudoun and Prince William, that certain Magisterial Districts have designated voting locations (see == for exact precincts in Loudoun, Prince William and Fairfax counties): FAIRFAX COUNTY Clifton Town Hall, 12641 Chapel Road, Clifton, VA 20124 FAUQUIER COUNTY Fauquier High School, 705 Waterloo Road, Warrenton, VA 20186 LOUDOUN COUNTY Loudoun Valley High School, 340 N Maple Ave, Purcellville, VA 20132 (Leesburg and Catoctin Districts and selected Blue Ridge precincts) Broad Run High School, 21670 Ashburn Rd, Ashburn, VA 20147 (Algonkian, Ashburn and Broad Run Districts) Mercer Middle School, 42149 Greenstone Dr, Aldie, VA 20105 (Dulles and Sterling Districts and selected Blue Ridge precincts) CITY OF MANASSAS Grace E. Metz Middle School, 9950 Wellington Rd, Manassas, VA 20110 MANASSAS PARK Manassas Park Community Center, 99 Adams St, Manassas Park, VA 20111 PRINCE WILLIAM COUNTY Bull Run Middle School, 6308 Catharpin Road, Gainesville, VA, 20155 (Gainesville District) Gainesville Middle School, 8001 Limestone Dr, Gainesville, VA 20155 (Brentsville District) Lake Jackson Vol. Fire Department, 11310 Coles Dr, Manassas, VA 20112 (Coles and Occoquan Districts) RAPPAHANNOCK COUNTY Rappahannock Co. Elem. School, 34 Schoolhouse Rd, Washington, VA 22747 Present your ID to verify you are a registered voter. IF YOU ARE NOT REGISTERED TO VOTE, PLEASE DO SO ASAP - you can go to the == to check on your status or register to vote. The ballot will have you rank your choices, mark CALEB MAX as your first choice (more on rank choice voting ==). Submit your ballot and you may leave...simple. Bring your friends and family and have them vote for Caleb Max! If you are unable to attend and have a good reason, you can in person absentee vote early at the following location: IN-PERSON ABSENTEE VOTING Thursday, May 12, 2022 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. The Middleburg Barn 23320 Foxchase Farm Lane Middleburg, VA 20117 So Mark Your Calendar today for Saturday, May 21 to Vote for Caleb!! . | | On The Campaign Trail Visit Our Website == | == Tonight I will be joining with the other Republican candidates at a Forum in Manassas. Please follow the link == for more information on the event and please follow this link == if you would like to learn more about my campaign and important issues that I defend. Last week, I had the pleasure to attend Blue Ridge Cattlemen Association dinner. The Association represents cattle raising families across Loudoun, Fauquier, Clarke and Jefferson (WV) counties. As a cattle farm owner in Round Hill, BRCA and Virginia Farm Bureau member plus long time 4H member growing up, I know the key issues facing our rural 10th CD community. I will fight for these small business owners on Capitol Hill!! | | == | == Hey everybody, I recorded a short video above (Or ==) talking about our final big push this week for the win on Saturday. If you would like a bumper sticker, yard sign or to hand out material in support of the campaign, please let us know. Thanks! Have we spoken yet? Since my announcement for Congress, I have been campaigning 24/7 and will do so all the way to November. Like my grandfather, former Congressman Frank Wolf, I believe in outstanding service to residents in the 10th. I will open offices in every county and have extended hours to serve you. If we have not spoken yet, please contact mailto:Scheduler@MaxForVirginia.com to arrange a time for me to call. Thank you! | | mailto:noah@maxforvirginia.com | | Country. Community. Common Sense. | | == | ---|--- | My campaign is focused on Country, Community and Common Sense. Country is ensuring that the United States remains an economic and military leader that stands as a beacon of hope for freedom seeking people around the world. Community is supporting the growth of the 10th District's dynamic economy and many small businesses and local organizations, which are the foundation of our society. And Common Sense is an understanding that we cannot continue with the fiscal irresponsibility of the past and must make the hardworking families of this district our main priority. Right now, working Americans suffer from the highest inflation rate in decades. I look forward to standing up to the Biden Administration and Jennifer Wexton's failed policies which hurt every working family in the 10th Congressional District. As the Republican candidate, we will win in November, flip the House of Representatives from blue to red, and put government back to work for the hardworking families and business owners who call the 10th District home. | | | == | | Learn More About Caleb | | Lifelong Loudoun County resident and business owner, Caleb was recently recognized by the == as a business and community leader. Like his grandfather, Caleb is passionate about the international human rights movement. He founded a national, bipartisan non-profit organization called the == and joined in starting Stand Against Chinese Communism (SACC). Both organizations are working to eliminate Chinese Communist Party influence on our college campuses. Caleb has taken a specific interest in fighting the genocide of the Uyghur Muslims and recently was recognized by the Virginia Muslim Association for his assistance to the Afghan refugee and Muslim community after President Biden's botched and deadly withdrawal from Afghanistan. | | WASHINGTON, DC. – I can't help but comment on members of Congress and their recent positions on important issues – issues that affect everyone in our nation. I'm disappointed to consistently learn of what appears to be a conflict of interest in governing, and it boils down to money. The influence of special interest groups, lobbyists, corporate PACS, and wealthy donors on American politics is too great. Congressional rules should not be more lenient than the executive branch which is reviewed for potential conflicts of interest, subjecting them to a requirement to divest, recuse or seek a waiver. The corruption isn't limited to a specific party either. Money influences Republicans and Democrats incumbents alike, and money gets them reelected. Even if legally acquired, politicians' financial benefit hinders their ability to do their jobs effectively. The more outside money politicians take, the less well they represent their constituents. The best leaders in Congress will follow their districts, not their donors. When you look at how our members of Congress vote, ask yourself — Did it benefit us in the district? Did they compromise their principles and not vote in the best interest of their constituents? Did they do it to get reelected? Too often what’s best for the people is thwarted for positions that benefit wealthy donors' wallets. We need to elect candidates that dare to do what is right and stand on principle regardless of how it will affect their campaign finances. **Campaign finance reform is overdue and much needed.** **In March,[we caught my opponent funding virtual campaign ads with tax-payer dollars](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45400008/345793732/-1222122770?fbclid=IwAR3sW3xDx_9PXeyipgk9udWMH7cOgs1_jNKDBGEEKwg_ihGgKtSHj3OqJHI&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMThmMWQ1Yi1kN2Q1LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=o3gkMKjwZETBQ756yC4gk_VhS0mwHBS90JhlL1-hATk=&emci=e5cc16da-d0d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=018f1d5b-d7d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=15167427) through his office account. subject: The key to Lincoln’s rhetorical success
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Eucli
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z1fu2eodp08ihu60uv5bjtbkgjssj3bg08fn6fno_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2ugpjepj4e9om9p1lcqqm3ctk6gr78p9i65rbfc35m4prcd9m6ti7eo73mtie1dtnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphhm2pmac3nc1j32d5jc3jr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or5c9jm9o33chi649fg)

---|---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z2jqrmc9i3td5hbeuniigteeuiu6oemqtpepugig_rp22sh2s8i66pb2ctie0or4chh2bs)
---
| | That’s why we need the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.
Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z0sg6itipdbm5vet3prp1flqfn58r816abrlj5f8_rp22sh2s8i66pb2ctie0or4chh2bs)
Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of liberty.
Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Hi Peter,

That's our little girl, Abby, you're looking at.

Back then, if you had told us our little girl would grow up to be elected to Congress and go on to challenge Sen. Chuck Grassley (who, by the way, was our senator even all those years ago!), well – we _absolutely_ would have believed you.
You see, Abby's always stuck up for what she believes in and fought for what's right. Since the age of 10, she has sat at the kitchen table with her grandfather and uncles – some of them Democrats, some of them Republicans – and talked politics. We may not have been able to give our daughter a trust fund or write a six-figure check for college, but what we did give her was her work ethic.

So as Abby grew up and saw work to be done, she signed up and _did_ the work. She won election to the Iowa House of Representatives at only 25 years old – and then four years later became the youngest woman to flip a U.S. House seat from Republican to Democratic. All along the way, she's been fighting for working families like ours.
We have complete faith that Abby will work her heart out and defeat Sen. Grassley. But we've seen how things work in Iowa. Last time around, our Senate election was one of the most expensive in the country. > _We thought you might want to see this special message from our friends at the new Republican Accountability PAC._
Friend,

Today is the day of the Pennsylvania Senate primary, and all of us at RAPAC are watching closely. Depending on who wins tonight, the Republican nominee is going to be either a quack, a phony, or a conspiracy theorist. This week’s Threat to Democracy of the Week is a triple threat, and it’s hard to say who’s the worst of the bunch.
---
---
As the race’s Trump-endorsed candidate, Mehmet Oz follows in Trump’s footsteps as a famous snake oil salesman. He’s notorious for peddling pseudoscientific medical advice on his TV show. Medical experts have found that [as much as half](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VVVpzw6Nnv26W87khDg8-k35kV3Z50p4K9s8mN46-8HJ5nKvpV3Zsc37CgM5FW1jF7D05w1BQQW2_KZZF3YgpNZVPtb-D8RvPS0W5-zknS6F0Cl0W8stBJ-6s39sZW32QN8m9jFLJ5VQ6ch561S_RtW5SNf_b3h3C4yW5KVKKF4KMpMBW61Rrg64F0X9wW1nLRV62NrF5VW3s7CTQ4YHccFW8XdPqd7rRkFJW15fC7Q54-4ZsN45bCbBhcYdRN5b7hsWngDd9W5F8Gt01htcYNW1D-yk52X0DdrW2trtPV5thQvTW41KfHk7tcdTsW7CvDZC96MmLsW1jz2yQ1gzJzCW2_cMJg51vbK2VmmfVt71Kg1VW39z89Q2Vrvk5Vh0PN-2wJJrKW34VXN686QsNfVC7pbf4Bh7fmW1jF6sb4qcR8KW7K0-1z2gycKjW8lF4q94WdjVZW7fJmy57wWZx7N7cCJqFSRrwlW1bfFp-2WVq743pyN1) of his medical advice has no scientific basis. And speaking of things that have no basis, Oz is running for Senate in a state that he has no real connection to. He’s using [his in-laws’](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VVVpzw6Nnv26W87khDg8-k35kV3Z50p4K9s8mN46-8Kt3q90_V1-WJV7CgGyGW50T-9w1nhw7TW1R1M4R7hSddHW963XXH7FkL8jW21vfNZ2Xy4YBW6vP67x8XTVMHW6-qCCp97B8JwVDYVk_2Tt1FyW93W99t3k0HzqW4DKKgx7GBWj9W92yZrl2hCL4NW97rzkm4Xpb9TW5TNw-R1CJ0P3N457g2fxb92mW8DWz1n9lvczzVBPPqm8wr4KHVJvP894x3vtLW7WMkvM1Xj3FyW5WRLd-2ClL6QW7qNR8z3h4Q5bW3wQzJq4FG9pzV4hQ6v6Mm4yhW3qtLJt1dsRVTW2jrlPs35b57VW31T4MT6b7t4GN2rRnyLGkK-fW5l1LV71QcpBnW700W_H67Pn19W4D7xQg86QC0kw1zFb49rTqW6xBzm27DyySb3j5r1) Pennsylvania address to register to vote in the state.
It gets worse—Oz also has some [uncomfortable connections](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VVVpzw6Nnv26W87khDg8-k35kV3Z50p4K9s8mN46-8Jh5nKv_V3Zsc37CgCcdW1pxzb88FRLMtW5zwcsW12SQPNW8cKYqb1Hr0f6W7wlDp73ZYvbRW2YZ4Hl3c-J39W3nzFqx8T5dglW7fq6r42DbVjxW4SL0gX5jqQTNW810YvB8HCc9LVX_HY66VnW9gW1HzyJP2-LVS3VhnrsN8TjkQvW2bH5Z71pWtvPW2QZM256yvnHRW1_w5hf4Y5YHtW3NtbPl4zqdLDW3WgWwX6thmrKW7r_MXH5GFsLDW8Wm2x05fyfxLVCQ2wD2sNp-JW5ZrH6D4lssPRW3f3tgg3MdgsCN5D1h4wkg0YsW2Gp00k9kCZm3W5V6r2P53_5F9W5y5v906Wbgs8W7f7Y595kZgnCW1SXpWL77tv4TW57hkS62LnYHhW8Pnr5g1S4syhW6BS9CF9hgWvSVcq74g53V566W6z-_607ySGwzW9f3t5n2bFflCW5WL1fk3y2-vgW4Ms8lq4mcx2-W4tD5V07_3K4KN1bQ3xD_k2CQ39Bz1) to the Turkish dictator Recep Tayyip Erdogan that make it clear why he’s Trump’s favorite. Fraudsters who admire dictators flock together, after all.
---
---
Oz isn’t the only threat to democracy in the PA Senate race, though. Hedge fund tycoon David McCormick went from [saying](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VVVpzw6Nnv26W87khDg8-k35kV3Z50p4K9s8mN46-8JB3q905V1-WJV7CgzJPW2CwyLZ2vnt7lW5Hg1Jx5ztTzyW3MZsqX2tbDP5W7__bzm1T_MSqW95rPny22Gs_ZW7sNfw68JN2nsV72sMG4V5TbyW63BdkP7WjL1TW4-hhyS2-R09LW29l_Sr53HMfvW8njcJK2BRMLQW4p9-hC83tDLLW8xX3tJ6PqQtWVX8QZF9lbkX_W3P2n9Z5drlcDW4mtBsq1GQnB2VXL7Vy8kfFxMW4q_wN95JXPTWW8z4C3s55Wv2YW6swxj13bLdf7W4wdg541K6ct8W1fkdgc5sldz7N4D5S3td8rDZW3Yv6yc7T8s4D3qmg1) Jan. 6 was “a dark chapter in American history” to trying out his best “[America First conservative](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VVVpzw6Nnv26W87khDg8-k35kV3Z50p4K9s8mN46-8JB3q905V1-WJV7CgMG4W5j5n9Y3vPfY6W57G3p-1v8gjNN5dZ6t0g1mRdW8sL9Vr7C99K9W79Wd_C3gq1HQW3jVch98VlRglW1_zx-q7Z2ls9W53KQTf531qZnW1xl08Z69Zqs5W8CHN0m8JCH2jW2R5kjC57DgHdF5VzbqxlcQCW1rS3mJ1mRDqfN200hyGvN4m1W88Kdp_7vm9rDW61XWSl5qwM3NW8qWWsw834TVVW7jF6Vr3W7c34W79dcpF5d4rW_W1smt3K7fKY-MW4v5Xqc3gxnmfW7FC1d23Vhv7MW4c_W9x20Hz7kW20dqjB73SXgY38461)” performance to get Trump’s endorsement. Even though Trump picked Oz, McCormick continues to pretend he’s been MAGA all along to appease the Trump base. If McCormick gets elected, how much further will he go to pander to Trump and his followers? The thing is, we don’t know. We can’t gamble the future of democracy on sell-outs like McCormick.
---
---
Last but certainly not least, Kathy Barnette wins the award for biggest conspiracy theorist in the race. She called the January 6 insurrection a [hoax](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VVVpzw6Nnv26W87khDg8-k35kV3Z50p4K9s8mN46-8Kt3q90_V1-WJV7CgXXHW45tblV3g69nHW3vlr3_3dJ2g6VhTFHx1NWvLMW4Y0T_32n08pLN4Khgy0-Qr9tW5DN0zh63Vc6qW53lkct2yQBcnW1Gpppp3W4YWkW1bXsfs3SxBfcW5-tv1c2jc3H1W8MyHBc8gkRtTN1XLMfX5m659VMnJWN1Gz65gW1LMbDD5kmgYbW1Jztb987XdFZVLgsVM5tRbHXW6XZbfL3g36nJW2dy6kz5Ft8fpW92lcBq56dWw1W1q9PMQ5cD7hpW17VBmT4TLm_WW6d81dm58_GKLW3YXJ8v4zCGWcW1f9T9J2cTl31W4Zg1hX8qYs0NW9jNmWQ8Dhx30W7nj34n7nrpbVW1SRkyL1KWg9QW5zGHZr3yD6wNW3WTFBg3hHpxD2J91) and [rented buses](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VVVpzw6Nnv26W87khDg8-k35kV3Z50p4K9s8mN46-8Hp5nKv5V3Zsc37CgT5hW4ndk_56pVGnpW93NRt14h3SbjW5F5psv4YxTqcW65lbXV7rWr2HVPWcK-7fbL19W80CDHg4w72PSW1PwCnP36Cs75W10qR1v4ztY8dW50k9k05cMsFCW8txLsk5Pq-NkN2VgGp8ypzYpW6lQ37J4k7Z7lW3Zkw7t625D8nN4SWGSl16ZtNW35j_j465B9_KVl8M6966v4qhW4kvDGd49y0vHW2JyjS47BMqTDW8R_DTw3DZPwWW7LfC5k6KCdrvW2LTHTD6pyvsgW12fqMn5mVC83N8KC7JbShLwgW7_hTw_8bltJ4W1DJnKr5XDf5BW2D9MBw95L8cQW74YNcN29b5QYW6BFQbR1Mh2P-W78j95c7sQqr5N3y8hYLrnLQTW5KGvgZ1Y1JRgW7gKqCt6bg5V43jR91) to bring people to the Capitol. She even alleged her congressional election in 2020 was stolen from her—despite losing by 20 points. This time, though, Barnette [climbed in the polls](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/VVVpzw6Nnv26W87khDg8-k35kV3Z50p4K9s8mN46-8Kt3q90_V1-WJV7CgH-9W1ZTd4M7J8-GhW64cvf44jqmTDW5cK5-D5LpbVZW3sn1wR5Zk5wyW3PY7CH1Z7J87W1z0QZy6JCR7-W5h1r97252DSZW4lGTby7NkFJhW4sd-Yf9c4S5tW7Pt07C203-MBW3fqPrl3lfl_JW2_Z-9s32tLvfW6m4PLL8702WZW2FTl--1Mbh0QW7M6rHw2LPvvzN5nsZbzBMPc4W4vhxkM3dDQVnW34QjCj3svJ9wW6X-Gld4Bt1Z1W2-yt2x3162H1N1r91byG3yfHW59bwjl5wG1kDW7kCdJR1SRLyHW4-mykb1-MGnYW4wJxzh4lNlwxW3D2S9l5xSL2WW2DG8Bm4Fb3NhW1Yp4HH1Wy28BW8_6s9q6tjrWnW14rMS-7cgvFC3lxc1) for the past few weeks—showing that the conspiracy angle is working for her. Her rise means that she very well could be Pennsylvania’s next U.S. Senator. She’s already been endorsed by Doug Mastriano, the QAnon-curious PA governor candidate who was last week’s Threat to Democracy of the Week. Pennsylvania’s Senate race is a toss-up, and Oz, McCormick, and Barnette all have a strong chance of winning this November. It’s why Pennsylvania is one of our key states for 2022. If you want to help us stop a MAGA minion from being your next senator, support our work. It’s going to take all of us. Sarah Longwell Treasurer, Republican Accountability PAC

| Over the past 13 months, I have laid out my experience, views, and priorities for moving Pennsylvania forward and bringing needed resources to the 182nd District of Philadelphia.

I hope that you share my vision for healthcare reform, reproductive freedom, improved infrastructure, fully-funded public education, public safety, family-sustaining union jobs, economic resurgence, and historic LGBTQ representation in Harrisburg.

**Today, the decision is yours.** **And no matter how you vote, your vote is the most important tool in our democracy.**

Polls are open today from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. _As long as you are in line by 8 p.m., you can vote._ You can find your polling place and the answers to FAQs about voting today at [www.votespa.com](https://dejaforpa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b6353e8c7ba78b936853cab9&id=a0f77d7469&e=3f8e2ea1e3).

I hope I have earned your support and look forward to serving as your next State Representative.

_Deja

Hey Peter,
Today’s the day–Election Day!
How will you be voting? Ballots either need to be postmarked today–aka put in the mail in time for the mail carrier to pick it up–or turned in to a ballot drop box by 8pm. [**Find a ballot drop box near you here!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45408650/345829066/719410068?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjllZmYyN2IwLWU5ZDUtZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4YzMyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=pnU7qEoT43A04oHFAfpZ1sEZOBHtF_Vg87Zso2eP22s=&emci=82712327-ffd2-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=9eff27b0-e9d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=2107230)
I like to vote on Election Day, so–with my dog, Luna–I’ll be walking over to a ballot drop box at my local library before 8pm tonight! What’s your voting plan? Will you be filling out your ballot while sipping your morning coffee, and then heading to a nearby ballot box? Or will you be walking out to the mailbox or post office with your own trusty companion?
However you vote, there are some amazing candidates to vote for in this election! And OLCV Endorsements are here to help you find all the pro-environment, pro-climate candidates on your ballot. Go to **olcv.org/2022-primary-endorsements** for a full list.
Happy Election Day!

Lindsey Scholten
Deputy Director, OLCV

| | Hey Peter, The primary election is only a few days away, and it’s easier than ever to vote–you just have to make sure that your ballot is postmarked (collected by USPS) on or before Tuesday, May 17th (Election Day), or you can turn your ballot in at a ballot drop box by 8 pm on May 17th. (Find a ballot box near you **[here](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45408652/345829082/719410068?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjllZmYyN2IwLWU5ZDUtZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4YzMyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=pnU7qEoT43A04oHFAfpZ1sEZOBHtF_Vg87Zso2eP22s=&emci=82712327-ffd2-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=9eff27b0-e9d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=2107230)**!) There’s a lot at stake this election, including deciding which candidates for governor are going to be on the ballot this November. You can find OLCV endorsements online [**here**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45408654/345829093/-1086607047?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjllZmYyN2IwLWU5ZDUtZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4YzMyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=pnU7qEoT43A04oHFAfpZ1sEZOBHtF_Vg87Zso2eP22s=&emci=82712327-ffd2-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=9eff27b0-e9d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=2107230)! I like to vote early, so I already mailed in my ballot. For governor, the choice was easy–I voted for former Oregon House Speaker Tina Kotek. Tina has a proven track record when it comes to climate. She’s been behind every one of Oregon’s greatest climate victories in the last ten years, and that’s just the beginning. I care about the climate, and about creating a better future for the next generation, and I know Tina does too. That’s why she’s endorsed by OLCV! She’s the climate champion in the race for governor, and I hope you’ll join me in filling in the box next to her name. Another climate champion–who I wish I could vote for, but I don’t live in her district–is Andrea Salinas for Congress. From her time as an OLCV board member to her work as a state representative, Andrea has shown up with a strong work ethic to fight for our climate and our future. Please vote for Andrea if you’re in her district! She’s up against Carrick Flynn, who–if you haven’t heard–is against protections for spotted owls and sympathetic to Timber Unity. In many cases, the primary election is going to determine what our choices look like this fall. Voting is easier than ever before, and there are some great candidates waiting for your vote. Be sure to check out all of OLCV’s endorsements at **olcv.org/2022-primary-endorsements** for a full list of climate and environmental champions. Happy voting!

Francesca Varela
Communications Coordinator, OLCV |

Lindsey Scholten Deputy Director, OLCV | \---- FWD: Original Message ---- | | | ---|--- | | Hey Peter, The primary election is only a few days away, and it’s easier than ever to vote–you just have to make sure that your ballot is postmarked (collected by USPS) on or before Tuesday, May 17th (Election Day), or you can turn your ballot in at a ballot drop box by 8 pm on May 17th. (Find a ballot box near you !) There’s a lot at stake this election, including deciding which candidates for governor are going to be on the ballot this November. You can find OLCV endorsements online ! I like to vote early, so I already mailed in my ballot. For governor, the choice was easy–I voted for former Oregon House Speaker Tina Kotek. Tina has a proven track record when it comes to climate. She’s been behind every one of Oregon’s greatest climate victories in the last ten years, and that’s just the beginning. I care about the climate, and about creating a better future for the next generation, and I know Tina does too. That’s why she’s endorsed by OLCV! She’s the climate champion in the race for governor, and I hope you’ll join me in filling in the box next to her name. Another climate champion–who I wish I could vote for, but I don’t live in her district–is Andrea Salinas for Congress. From her time as an OLCV board member to her work as a state representative, Andrea has shown up with a strong work ethic to fight for our climate and our future. Please vote for Andrea if you’re in her district! She’s up against Carrick Flynn, who–if you haven’t heard–is against protections for spotted owls and sympathetic to Timber Unity. In many cases, the primary election is going to determine what our choices look like this fall. Voting is easier than ever before, and there are some great candidates waiting for your vote. Be sure to check out all of OLCV’s endorsements at olcv.org/2022-primary-endorsements for a full list of climate and environmental champions. Happy voting! body:

| [ ](http://crystalcavalier.nationbuilder.com/?e=48a1fa12922bf6601cd5922bccf65622&utm_source=crystalcavalier&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day&n=1)

Friend -- Today’s the day! Polls are open across District 4 from 6:30am until 7:30pm. Check your polling location here: [**ncvoter.fyi/polling**](https://crystalcavalier.nationbuilder.com/r?u=81_f5GkV8q_rK9ibKPVA9KB1Up5jqdllLzYRJTek_jA&e=48a1fa12922bf6601cd5922bccf65622&utm_source=crystalcavalier&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day&n=2)
#### With 8 candidates running, many folks are still on the fence about who they’re voting for today in our District 4 Democratic Primary. This day presents each of us with an abundance of opportunities to engage our loved ones and community members about what voting for Crystal means to us. The best pitch comes from the heart, and it might sound something like:
### “If elected, Crystal will be the first American Indian Frontline Climate Activist to represent North Carolina in Congress, and she will lead from her lived experience as a marginalized, working-class mother. Crystal represents the change our world needs.”
#### **Who are 3 people in District 4 you can check in with today about voting for Crystal? Let's give Election Day all we've got.**
* * *
### Join our Election Night Team Dinner!
7:30pm-9pm TONIGHT @ Vimala’s Cafe in Chapel Hill. [Please RSVP here.](https://crystalcavalier.nationbuilder.com/r?u=uuUyPGiVHWR_V3cUbcvCWYT5GAAYfCKfPrDVDaMJ8vRg4XSimJw8hWEE8pRTKy81MLZZ7GNUMLy_cZcy3pXmrqQrlmfRJbq0E7MVbnyaqqgtvuo6Pcr_oY97VZI7jEG7sn3-H8JMjyFnadUqU8PFNw&e=48a1fa12922bf6601cd5922bccf65622&utm_source=crystalcavalier&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day&n=3) While we fill up on delicious food and await the results, Crystal will be speaking alongside former Vice President Al Gore at the National Museum of African American History and Culture, as part of a much-needed climate discussion hosted by [Black Interfaith in the Time of Climate Crisis.](https://crystalcavalier.nationbuilder.com/r?u=p4dLxW9LbsiGXson--QwdbdKMSou9ZLNhWyqxfzjJrQqt4kOL26jGel-PjFkJqv5gNXDQOcV29tvE5MsqRf9O5yT6s1XeTwoYmFP9t9uATNvz0lNfyDinzghswng0Sg5A3QLVOWDgcWZ4mYG8RxAnQ&e=48a1fa12922bf6601cd5922bccf65622&utm_source=crystalcavalier&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day&n=4) [_Click here to watch the livestream at 5:30pm!_](https://crystalcavalier.nationbuilder.com/r?u=dwUDTtMz4jOAYyQqpqU72x8LKZNjkWBx6u4RfQg5_BZpdQzQvc5RCEV2TNTrq_hYuQZSCXG47qPoyCnJsLWsVxJlcQ2GPZ5--KLfCHfcGIk&e=48a1fa12922bf6601cd5922bccf65622&utm_source=crystalcavalier&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=day&n=5) **We can’t wait to gather with you, cross this finish line together and express our gratitude.** With full hearts, Team Crystal

name: =?utf-8?Q?Phil=20Scott?=
subject: More work to do
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Phil Scott for Vermont, Glen Wright, Treasurer,
body:
First, I want to thank you for all the support you’ve given me over the years. |
---
| | [ ](https://philscott.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bbb0245bb16226cd6570f0156&id=076e98137e&e=19cebfe173)
---
| Friend,
---
| First, I want to thank you for all the support you’ve given me over the years. In that time, we’ve made a lot of progress, like record budget surpluses and record investments in housing, infrastructure, broadband, combating climate change, and more. We’ve stopped multiple attempts to raise taxes, fees and the cost of living on already overburdened Vermonters. And while not nearly enough, we’ve even provided some much needed tax relief. We’ve proven that when we put politics aside and pull together, we can successfully navigate a once-in-a-century pandemic better than most every other state across the country. At a time when America seems more divided and polarized than ever, I’ve worked to bring people together. Listening to – and learning from – all points of view, so we can try to find consensus. Always treating others – even when we fundamentally disagree – with respect and dignity. And I’ve never run a negative campaign and never will, because Vermonters, and all Americans, deserve a better and more civil political space – if for no other reason than to be better role models for our children, because they’re watching us. Together, we’ve made a difference. But there’s still much more work to do! That’s why I’ve decided to seek another term as governor. My priority won’t be campaigning. I will continue to focus on doing the job you hired me to do and leading our state. You’ll hear more from me in the months ahead, but for now, I just wanted to let you know what I’ve decided. Thank you for having my back. I’ve always said, whether it's business, politics or racing, success is always about the team you surround yourself with. And I’m honored to have you on mine. Sincerely, Phil

| | Good morning friends!

This is it: **Election Day is TODAY in PA-17 and the polls are now OPEN (from 7am to 8pm)!**

With the help of supporters like yourself, we were able to reach and contact hundreds of thousands of voters in Allegheny and Beaver counties.

I’m already out at the polls greeting voters and I'll be spending the entire day rallying our supporters across District 17 to VOTE and get out their family and friends.

**Please forward this email to 5 people you know to remind them to vote!**

If you or anyone you know needs help getting to the polls, please let me know - we can help!

I've been so encouraged by all the support we've received - and I couldn't be more proud of everything we've accomplished together.

Thank you for your vote, your support, and your prayers. We wouldn’t be here today without you.

Now let's go win this!

With gratitude,
Jeremy Shaffer

P.S. - we have volunteers helping us with poll-greeting around the district today. If you have an hour or two to help out, reach out to our campaign manager [Trevor](mailto:trevor@jeremyshaffer.com?subject=Jeremy%20Shaffer%20for%20Congress%20\(PA-17\)) (508-826-5135) and he'll let you know where to go.

P.P.S. - after polls close at 8pm, join us The Clubhouse Gibsonia (5301 Ranalli Dr, Gibsonia, PA 15044) to watch election results come in!
**THANK YOU!**

subject: Endorsed By Former D.C. Councilman Brandon Todd!
body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
I’m delighted to have received the endorsement of former Washington, D.C. Councilman Brandon Todd!
Brandon, I can’t thank you enough for your trust and friendship. You’ve been a stalwart champion for our neighbors in Washington, and I look forward to partnering with you to deliver the results that will help Maryland and our region prosper.
You can learn more about why Brandon is endorsing our campaign by watching our new video below:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/brandontoddendorsement?amount=20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/brandontoddendorsement?amount=20.22]
As the Local Candidate for Governor, the people of Maryland know me, and I know them. I’ve received more endorsements than any other candidate in this race, and our coalition of support only continues to grow stronger in these final weeks before election day.
We have the momentum in this race – and with your help, we can pull ahead even further in this critical period for our campaign. Will you help make this moment count by chipping in to power our movement to victory? We’re looking to gain 50 new grassroots donations by 11:59 PM tonight, and your support can help get us there.
CHIP IN $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/brandontoddendorsement?amount=10]
CHIP IN $20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/brandontoddendorsement?amount=20.22]
CHIP IN $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/brandontoddendorsement?amount=50]
CHIP IN $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/brandontoddendorsement?amount=100]
CHIP IN ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/brandontoddendorsement]
We have an exciting opportunity to change the way that government does business in the years to come. My bold vision for Maryland includes combating the student debt crisis, protecting and expanding access to abortion care, leveling the playing field for Black Marylanders, and so much more. I am asking you to help make this vision a reality.
With just weeks to go until the July 19 primary, our people-powered movement continues to gain momentum. We are so close to the finish line – help us keep our foot on the gas!
Thank you,
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/Franchot%20Signature.png]

| | Dear , Senator Marco Rubio has long epitomized the worst of the Washington DC establishment, and the Democrat who is overwhelmingly favored to get their nomination to challenge him, Congresswoman Val Demings, offers voters a record that is also defined by her devotion to her party's establishment. Unsurprisingly, neither has anything to offer to the serious liberty-minded voter. Dear
Friend,
I hear
from people all the time that Thomas Sowell is one of their
heroes. For those people-and you may be among them-I'm thrilled
to share a digital copy of one of his commentaries with you,
absolutely free: "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax Cuts for the
Rich."

"Tax cuts
for the rich" is a favorite argument of those who oppose lower
tax rates. But does imposing higher tax rates on wealthy
Americans actually increase the amount of revenue coming into the
federal government?

Hoover
Institution Senior Fellow Thomas Sowell takes an empirical
approach in his commentary, "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax Cuts
for the Rich."

Sowell
separates fact from fiction when it comes to tax rates and uses
real life data and examples to prove that lower tax rates for all
actually lead to greater revenue for the government.

As a
friend and supporter of the Hoover Institution, we are proud to
offer you this valuable, thought-provoking resource free of
charge.

for the Rich" now.

I entered the police academy because I loved my community and wanted to protect it from harm. After graduating at the top of my class, I woke up and put on my uniform every day, ready to risk my life because _ _ I took an oath to protect and serve the people of Florida.
**While I was working the midnight shift, Marco Rubio was plotting his trajectory as a career politician. **I’ll put my record up against his any day – but the problem is, Rubio has the powerful influence of the GOP dark-money machine on his side.
As national Republicans spend millions of dollars on attack ads that question my loyalty to the men and women in law enforcement, I need your help today to set the record straight: [**Will you donate $5 or more to help me reach more voters and flip Florida blue?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45422369/345876411/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk3198-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTY4NzcwOS0wMGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gtCwPCzR3TiMSAqerDMtWh73XW4QhOezDWZdVsHjmoA=)

Back in 1983, **I was one of only three women in my police academy class**. But after years of hard work and dedication, I rose to the top of the department and became the first woman to serve as Orlando's chief of police.
My story doesn't stop there. When I was appointed chief of police, Orlando was in crisis. The murder rate was at an all-time high, but I brought the department together and built relationships within the community. Standing with the brave men and women of the Orlando Police Department, we reduced violent crime by 40%.
To protect the city of Orlando, it took long, sleepless nights. And if I'm elected to the Senate, I'm ready to spend long nights protecting our right to vote, reproductive rights, access to health care and so much more.
I'll never stop fighting to protect and serve. If you're with me, please donate $5 or whatever you can right now to flip Florida blue.
