body:
“Mike, I have to say, I was actually impressed by your debate performance. I mean that.” – Mack | | | |
---
| | |
## Great Comments. Great Debate.
---
|
---
|
#### “I think you did very well Captain Mike. Your countenance was unmatched in my opinion. I liked your nuanced answers to the yes or no q’s In particular the one on abortion. ‘Flopping like a fish on a dock’ was the best line of the debate.” – Kevin

“Great speech at the end Mike.” – Julie

“Mike, I have to say, I was actually impressed by your debate performance. I mean that.” – Mack

“Thank you for being the sole voice not crapping on our school system. Most people in Northern Michigan go to public schools & they don’t resemble what those other candidates described. I found the other candidates answers on education to be repulsive.” – Matt

“Mike’s recognition of his wife, Lori was superb. Everyone found Lori to be thoughtful, intelligent and kind. Happy 30th anniversary Mike and Lori.” – Cheryl
---
|
---
| **Peter** :

These are just some of the responses I received following the first Republican debate hosted by the Livingston County Republican Party. It set the stage for the run to August and November. If you didn’t get to watch it, it’s available here: [WWMT.com.](https://captainmikeformichigan.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4c9e98e87232d3682c652313&id=919785eefe&e=0636b97700)

It was great to also interact with attendees. Lots of great folks. Really energized me.
---
|
---
---
| There was a lot of pandering by the others, which is to be expected, particularly when it comes to President Trump and the 2020 election.

There was some controversy there, and I find it laughable how some of the candidates are bending over backwards trying to align themselves with President Trump when not one of them donated to help him – not one dime, not one dollar – from 2015 to 2020.
---
| |
---
_I did. Multiple times. I supported President Trump and I have the receipts to back it up._

The other candidates?

Not one of them can say the same. They're all Johnny-come-latelies to the GOP and President Trump.

Check the records.
---
| By the way, _I do believe there was fraud in the 2020 election_. But there is zero evidence that it was enough to change the outcome of the election. My entire life I’ve dealt in facts and evidence, so I’ve looked long and hard. I don’t believe the evidence is there.

I challenge the other candidates to prove me wrong since I'm the _original Trump supporter in this campaign_ and the _only one who has actually won an election_.
---
|
---
| Lots of other great activity around the state last week too. I got my hands dirty helping our volunteer crew put up a large number of 4’ x 8’ signs.

Coming to a road near you too soon.

**Want to help me return common sense to the Governor’s office?** Email [captainmikeformichigan@gmail.com](mailto:captainmikeformichigan@gmail.com) a location for a sign. Busy roads, interstate property, M roads are great spots.

### Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula
I will be on a 3 day swing through Northern MI and the UP May 22-23. We’re heading all the way west to Ironwood. Stop by one of our events and say hello. We’ll be publishing more soon.

That’s it for now. See you on the campaign trail!

Michael Brown

subject: Session In Review: Attacks on LGBTQ+
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Tennessee Democratic Party
body:
Republicans need to focus on bills that actually help Tennesseans.

| Republicans in our state would rather focus on discrimination instead of helping people make ends meet. It’s time to focus on the issues that actually help the people of Tennessee live better lives. That’s why we’re working to elect more Democrats into the State House who will use their power to fight for an economy that puts working people first.

[**_If you agree, donate $5 right now to help Take Back Tennessee._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45423156/345880414/1141538894?refcode=EM_FR_220517SessionLGBTQ_LEGE_TNDP_30DO180DD_8_NG_N_l1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzEzNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmOGFlNzlkMS0wMmQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3IxCyUzWPDyvJViQdLgSd9sdn0_PL3Zs40jnUJR9USg=)
---
Peter –
This is the kind of stigma that is literally killing our LGBTQ+ community:
* **PASSED: Republican bill SB1861 requires a students' "sex at the time of birth to be confirmed" before participating in a school sport.** Not only is this harmful to trans kids, but how would this even work in practice? Who would be confirming a students' sex and gender and how? Beyond the blatant transphobia of this bill, this will create invasive and inappropriate situations for all our children.
* **PASSED: Republican bill SB2153 prohibits trans women from participating in public higher education women’s sports.** There isn’t a single piece of evidence that shows trans students have an athletic advantage over cisgender students. Not one. The only thing this bill does is discourage trans youth from playing sports, further disconnecting them from their peers.
* **INTRODUCED: Republican bill SB 0562 establishes common law marriage in the state between one man and one woman AND would have legalized child marriage.** Even if legalizing child marriage was “an accident” that they eventually amended, this bill only serves to make getting married more difficult for same-sex couples. Same-sex marriage is a nationally-protected right and yet Republicans still spend the state’s limited time and resources trying to stop it.

[**_Republicans would rather spend our state’s limited time and resources attacking LGBTQ+ individuals than improving our economy, investing in education, or providing services to our residents in need. We deserve legislators in office who will fight to actually improve the lives of Tenesseeans. Beyond the blatant transphobia of this bill, this will create invasive and inappropriate situations for all our children. INTRODUCED: Republican bill SB 0562 establishes common law marriage in the state between one man and one woman AND would have legalized child marriage. **Opinion: Gov. DeWine’s schedule is also the people’s schedule - and needs to be treated as such**
"One conceivable aim of DeWine’s administration: To conceal, in his daily calendar, what was discussed in certain meetings. One is a 2019 meeting with a FirstEnergy Corp. official before DeWine signed a $1 billion bailout – to be paid by Ohio electricity customers – of money-losing nuclear power plants then owned by a subsidiary of the Akron electric utility."
Team, since taking legal action against Governor Mike DeWine, we're still working on getting answers about his involvement in the FirstEnergy scandal, which hard-working Ohioans are still forced to pay $287,000 _every single day for._

|
,

I'm wholeheartedly committed to fighting back against the woke indoctrination agenda of the radical left.

Our children are too important to leave in the hands of woke school boards - especially when the school boards care more about their political agendas than about our children's educations.

We don't need the woke left teaching our children _what_ to think. We need real educators to teach our children _how_ to think critically and for themselves.

That's why I have ALWAYS opposed Critical Race Theory in our schools, stood with parents, and voted to cut funding to these divisive programs in our local government.

Take a look here:

Now I'm running for Congress because the divisive, woke agenda of the left doesn't just exist at the local level.

My opponent Jennifer Wexton, enabled by Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi, has pushed the divisive 'equity' agenda at the federal level.

As your representative, I will stand up for parents and put a stop to the woke agenda that has permeated our communities and devastated our children.

I'm ready to send Jennifer Wexton and her woke agenda home this November, but I need your help to do it. [Will you make a small donation of $100, $50, $25, or even just $10 to help us get our message out and put an end to the divisive agenda of the radical left?](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=a3864f0481&e=fc83fb200d)

| | **_FIND YOUR MAY 21ST VOTING LOCATION_**
On May 21st, voting will be open from 9am-4pm. Your voting location is determined by where you live, and you will not be allowed to vote anywhere other than your designated voting location. You can find a full list of voting locations at [www.JeanineLawson.com/Voting](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=7373f5d360&e=fc83fb200d)

For additional help determining your voting location, please call 571-484-4425 or email [info@jeaninelawson.com](mailto:info@jeaninelawson.com) and we can help you determine where to vote.

**Prince William County: **your voting location will be determined by your magisterial district.

If you live in **Brentsville District represented by Supervisor Jeanine Lawson** , your voting location will be Gainesville Middle School located at 8001 Limestone Drive, Gainesville.

If you live in **Gainesville District represented by Supervisor Pete Candland**, your voting location will be Bull Run Middle School located at 6308 Catharpin Road, Gainesville.

If you live in **Coles District represented by Supervisor Yesli Vega or in Occoquan District**, your voting location will be Lake Jackson Fire Station located at 11310 Coles Drive, Manassas.

**Loudoun County: **Your voting location will be determined by your magisterial district _unless you live in Blue Ridge District represented by Supervisor Tony Buffington._

If you live in **Blue Ridge district** , your district is split between two voting locations. Find your precinct by visiting the [State Board of Elections website](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=3a6c2b8445&e=fc83fb200d).
Blue Ridge precincts 301, 302, 303, 305, 308, 310, 311, and 315 vote at Loudoun Valley High School.
Blue Ridge precincts 307, 309, 312, 313, 314, 316, 318, 319, 320, 321, and 322 vote at Mercer Middle School.

If you live in **Catoctin, Leesburg, or portions of Blue Ridge** districts, your voting location will be Loudoun Valley High School located at 340 N. Maple Avenue, Purcellville.

If you live in **Algonkian, Ashburn, or Broad Run** districts, your voting location is Broad Run High School located at 21670 Ashburn Road, Ashburn.

If you live in **Sterling, Dulles, or portions of Blue Ridge **districts, your voting location is Mercer Middle School located at 42149 Greenstone Drive, Aldie.

**Fauquier County:** Your county-wide voting location will be Fauquier High School located at 705 Waterloo Road, Warrenton.

**Rappahannock County** : Your county-wide voting location will be Rappahannock County Elementary School located at 34 Schoolhouse Road, Washington.

**Fairfax County** : Your voting location for all voters in the 10th district will be the Clifton Town Hall located at 12641 Chapel Road, Clifton.

**Manassas City** : Your city-wide voting location will be Grace E. Metz Middle School located at 9950 Wellington Road, Manassas.

**Manassas Park City** : Your city-wide voting location will be the Manassas Park Community Center located at 99 Adams Street, Manassas Park.

If you have any questions, please call 571-484-4425 or email [info@jeaninelawson.com](mailto:info@jeaninelawson.com)and we can help you determine where to vote.

clean_body: As the House GOP leader, I see a lot of impressive conservatives every day.| | | Peter, I’ll make this quick. As the House GOP leader, I see a lot of impressive conservatives every day. But few have impressed me like former Green Beret Col. Mike Waltz. Mike put his life on the line to defend our country in Afghanistan, and he brings the same grit and perseverance that he used on the battlefield to Congress every day to fight for a conservative future. He is a true American success story, but he isn’t just going to sit back and enjoy his accomplishments - he wants every American to reap the same benefits of hard work in the greatest country on Earth as he has. Right now, Mike is a top target for the radical Left, and if we’re going to create a conservative, America first future, we need to keep this American hero in Congress. The conservative veterans like Mike Waltz who work alongside me are some of the fiercest Republican defenders in Congress, Peter. They risked their lives for the freedoms we too often take for granted. And now that they’re under attack from within our OWN country from the socialist Left, they won’t rest until they’ve secured that freedom for the next generation. From standing up for our veterans when Joe Biden leaves them behind to looking the evils of socialism and Communist China in the eye, Mike has YOUR America-first interests at heart in everything he does. You want to argue the Ukraine aid bill was too expensive? I'd agree. But I don't get to vote for "perfect" \- I get a yes or no vote.
And given the option to severely degrade the Russian military's capabilities for years to come, without sacrificing a single American soldier, allowing us to focus on more serious threats like China, then hell yes I'll make that investment.
No, this doesn't mean we don't care about the border or baby formula. When we retake the House the border will be a number one priority. Unfortunately the Dems in charge right now don't care, so we don't get to address those issues. These are not mutually exclusive issues either, and to treat them as such is to admit we can't walk and chew bubble gum. But we can. This is America, and we aren't putting America first when we leave our border open or let Russia and China reshape the global order to their liking.

name: Kirsten Gillibrand
subject: I just returned from Buffalo
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
Friends,
This morning, I stood alongside President Biden and families of the victims to grieve in the wake of Saturday’s deadly mass shooting in Buffalo.
I want to be clear about what happened on Saturday: A man, fueled by racism, hate, and white supremacist ideology, drove over 100 miles to specifically target a predominantly Black community in Buffalo, murdering ten innocent people.
As a nation, we must reckon with the truth: That white supremacy, racism and domestic terrorism are being embraced across the country. We’ve seen it in Charleston. We’ve seen it in Pittsburgh. In El Paso. And now in Buffalo—the City of Good Neighbors.
My heart aches for the victims of this horrific act, for their loved ones, and for the entire Buffalo community. And my heart aches for the Black community—in Buffalo and across the country—who once again must contend with extraordinary loss for the simple act of existing.
We have so much work to do.
As a community, to heal. And as elected leaders, to secure some semblance of justice for the families who lost their loved ones. And to enact policies that prevent history from repeating itself—from passing gun safety measures to defeating domestic terrorism.
This will not be easy. It will take time. But I will share with you the same pledge I made to the people of Buffalo today: I will fight every day to make these changes. To honor those who we lost. To take the example of their lives, and bring about meaningful change in their names.
Please join me in sending love, strength, and resolve to the people of Buffalo,
Kirsten

# TODAY IS THE DAY!
Today, all of our hard work pays off. Our amazing team of volunteers has done a spectacular job of spreading our message of freedom and encouraging conservatives to vote for individual liberty, state sovereignty, and traditional conservative values. **I am so thankful to the many Idahoans who have put time, effort, and money into our campaign. Your contributions are greatly appreciated.** Due to redistricting, many polling locations have changed, so if you aren't sure where to vote, you can use [this tool from the Secretary of State](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=f9c724c736&e=823fa8e224) to find your polling location. This weekend at church I was struck by what a great blessing it is to be surrounded by people of faith who believe in God's promise for our state.
---
|
---
---
| In addition to the high-profile endorsements I have received from [President Trump](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=7333919998&e=823fa8e224), [Michelle Malkin](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=c336c70a02&e=823fa8e224), [Sen. Wendy Rogers](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=547b55d5a8&e=823fa8e224), and [Alan Keys](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=af4f5c38cd&e=823fa8e224), I have received the endorsements of [True Idaho News](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=c339bc38bb&e=823fa8e224), [Redoubt News](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=7f01848811&e=823fa8e224), and the [Gem State Patriot](https://janicemcgeachin.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=75545c0bb4a66af3c4692bc0e&id=47d26dca79&e=823fa8e224).
---
| There is much at stake in this election. Idaho's future and independence are on the line. Did you know that Facebook's Public Policy Manager recently joined the board of IACI? Will Idaho become a vassal state to massive corporations who manipulate elections and tax policy to their advantage?
---
| In just the final week of the campaign, 322,521 calls have been made to reach out to Idahoans and ask for their vote. The work for our campaign doesn't stop until the final vote is cast. Our internal polling shows this is a close race and we are very optimistic about today's outcome, but WE NEED YOUR HELP to get out the vote. Thousands of potential voters may forget or neglect to vote today unless reminded. Call your conservative friends and neighbors and encourage them to vote. Help them know who the conservative candidates are in their area. **If every conservative voter would make even 1-2 calls today, it could make a monumental difference in Idaho's future.**
## Please vote McGeachin for Governor.
**Please vote to Make Idaho Free Again!**
---
| Sincerely,

Janice McGeachin for Idaho Governor

| Peter,

One of my top priorities in Congress is to deliver results for my constituents to improve their lives. In office, I've done just that - _**and I 've reached across the aisle to do it.**_

I'm proud to be **the most bipartisan representative Virginia has in Congress** , and my collaboration with colleagues has led to lasting change for our community.

Last fall, I helped pass the bipartisan infrastructure package. Among its benefits, this law will fix our roads and bridges, purify our drinking water, improve rural broadband internet connectivity, and invest in clean, renewable energy.

_**Transformative moments like when President Biden signed this bill into law are an inspiring reminder of what our government is capable of when we come together.**_

Similarly, I am leading the bipartisan charge to ban stock trading by members of Congress and their spouses. This commonsense reform has broad support and would affirm for our constituents we are in Congress to serve them, not our financial portfolios.

[_**I am eager to continue impactful work like this in Congress next year, and I 'm counting on your support to power this campaign to victory. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45428332/345903907/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1005-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTA0NzA0OS0xNGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z-TYkmG_aqP1EEgzumkWyY8LSTn-3DfF6-TRnO0H00Y=)
My dad was a World War II veteran who survived the Battle of the Bulge. He used to look over the corner of his newspaper at the breakfast table and ask my siblings and me, “What are you doing for freedom today?”
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45428333/345903908/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1005-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTA0NzA0OS0xNGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z-TYkmG_aqP1EEgzumkWyY8LSTn-3DfF6-TRnO0H00Y=)
That's a big question for three kids trying to finish their cereal, but it's one I make a point to answer every day. I first got my start in public service as an advocate, helping to ensure that children like my son Ben, who has cerebral palsy, would be fully included in their communities and have the same opportunities that all parents want for their children.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45428334/345903909/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1005-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTA0NzA0OS0xNGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z-TYkmG_aqP1EEgzumkWyY8LSTn-3DfF6-TRnO0H00Y=)
In the Senate, I was one of the deciding votes to save the Affordable Care Act in 2017. If it weren't for 1,017 votes in New Hampshire less than a year before, a Republican would have been in my seat, and millions of Americans could have lost their health care coverage.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45428335/345903910/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1005-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTA0NzA0OS0xNGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z-TYkmG_aqP1EEgzumkWyY8LSTn-3DfF6-TRnO0H00Y=)
It is the honor of my lifetime to represent Granite Staters, and I’m not done fighting for New Hampshire. From lowering the cost of prescription drugs to ending Big Oil’s billions in tax breaks, I'll continue working to ensure that all Americans, regardless of personal circumstances, have the opportunity to succeed.

But here's the deal: **Mitch McConnell only has to flip one seat to take back the Senate, and I'm at the top of his list.** That's why GOP groups have spent more against me than any other Senate Democrat ($7.8 million and counting).

I hate asking for money, but I really need your help to win this November. **[_If you can, please chip in $3, or as much as you're comfortable with, to defend my seat and protect the Senate from the GOP control._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45428336/345903911/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&amount=3&refcode=mh-jtk1005-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTA0NzA0OS0xNGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z-TYkmG_aqP1EEgzumkWyY8LSTn-3DfF6-TRnO0H00Y=)**
I really appreciate it!

With every good wish,
Maggie Hassan

## Primary day!
---
---
|
---
**Today is Primary Day** , the last day to return your ballot (postmarked or in a drop box by 8pm)! Your support and advice have been invaluable during this election, and all I feel right now is **deep gratitude to you**.Some of you donated, others challenged me, and still others gave time and talent to my campaign for Oregon Commissioner of Labor and Industries. **Thank you, from the bottom of my heart.** If you have not voted yet, there are other super-important primaries that deserve your attention all over Oregon. I’ve met, talked, cried, and shared meals with many of the candidates for office, and I come away so hopeful for our future. **Voting is important** , _and_ voting alone is not enough. **We will always be striving towards a more perfect union, and I’ll be right alongside you.** Thank you again.With hope,Casey

Peter, In exactly one week, Georgians will be headed to the polls to vote in this year's primary election. ** ** Marjorie Taylor Greene didn't even know if she would be on the ballot this upcoming Tuesday. Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zn4c6sgq7k0okkbenujel27cik15gd0hjvc88ico_rp22sh2s8i66pb2c3i62o72chh2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. And then over the weekend, multiple mass shootings took dozens of lives—most notably, the horrific and racially-motivated shooting at a grocery store in Buffalo, New York. Americans are _constantly_ reminded of Congress’s failure to protect us from gun violence—at music festivals and nightclubs, elementary schools and colleges, and now, at the grocery store. Yet, common sense gun policies have long been supported by a majority of Americans, and voters have given Congress an urgent mandate to enact these life-saving provisions. So, why the delay? Money talks, and people like Ann Wagner listen. Since 2013, [Ann has actively fought against even the most popular, least controversial gun safety measures](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45428737/345905657/765017620?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjAzMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNTA1MzBmMy0xNmQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=iA_5Z_vh8Kvcy1Yx_SNB_UrAmK_QqRBXyJCWs2lSyLg=&emci=359b51d7-34d5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=f50530f3-16d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=14943357) to keep cozy with right-wing agitators who have fueled racial resentment, division, and gaslit millions of people to commit violence against anyone who doesn’t fit their definition of a "real" American. And she’s done it so well, the NRA has consistently fawned over her. But I’m so damn tired of the "thoughts and prayers" we get from Washington power players like Wagner after Americans are senselessly slaughtered. If they truly cared, they would do something about it. Wagner and her allies must own the outcomes of their rhetoric which compels domestic terrorists like Kyle Rittenhouse, Dylan Roof, and the murderer who took innocent lives in Buffalo this past weekend to commit violence. Their actions are byproducts of the same forces that keep Ann Wagner in office. And it's on us to work as hard as possible to defeat them to ensure they no longer have the platform to manipulate and divide us for political gain. In a society already awash with guns, their racist instigation has a predictable end. Lives are at stake, and we cannot afford to let these cynical politicians make decisions that will keep us, and our children, in a perpetual state of fear and danger. And then over the weekend, multiple mass shootings took dozens of lives—most notably, the horrific and racially-motivated shooting at a grocery store in Buffalo, New York. Americans are constantly reminded of Congress’s failure to protect us from gun violence—at music festivals and nightclubs, elementary schools and colleges, and now, at the grocery store. Yet, common sense gun policies have long been supported by a majority of Americans, and voters have given Congress an urgent mandate to enact these life-saving provisions. So, why the delay? Money talks, and people like Ann Wagner listen. Since 2013, to keep cozy with right-wing agitators who have fueled racial resentment, division, and gaslit millions of people to commit violence against anyone who doesn’t fit their definition of a "real" American. And she’s done it so well, the NRA has consistently fawned over her. But I’m so damn tired of the "thoughts and prayers" we get from Washington power players like Wagner after Americans are senselessly slaughtered. If they truly cared, they would do something about it. Wagner and her allies must own the outcomes of their rhetoric which compels domestic terrorists like Kyle Rittenhouse, Dylan Roof, and the murderer who took innocent lives in Buffalo this past weekend to commit violence. Their actions are byproducts of the same forces that keep Ann Wagner in office. And it's on us to work as hard as possible to defeat them to ensure they no longer have the platform to manipulate and divide us for political gain. In a society already awash with guns, their racist instigation has a predictable end. Lives are at stake, and we cannot afford to let these cynical politicians make decisions that will keep us, and our children, in a perpetual state of fear and danger. Choose a candidate who can win in November
| | | |

|
---
|
# Vote in the primary for a candidate who can win in the fall
---
|
---
|
---
| From out-of-control inflation, increasing unaffordability nationwide, skyrocketing crime in every city, the invasion of criminal elements through our porous southern border, the fentanyl crisis, and unprecedented geopolitical instability that could end in major global conflict--it seems everything is going wrong, and it is. Radical Progressive policies, seemingly by design, are destroying this country, eroding American strength, and threatening our children's future. However, all these crises are merely symptoms of a root problem--extraordinary corruption in DC. The Progressive Road leads to ruin and is paved with corruption. That is why you must elect candidates with exemplary character, exceptional fortitude, and the ability to tackle the greatest challenges of our times. Not only must these candidates be able to win the General election against a well- fortified Left with nearly endless resources and the media on their side, but they must also be able to do the job once they get to Washington. When you assess a candidate without a voting record, you have only their credentials and their rhetoric to go on. How often do politicians say one thing, then do another? It seems now to be the exception rather than the rule that a politician does what he or she says they will do. In essence, the character of the candidate matters more than anything. Second to that perhaps, is their ability to actually solve some of the most pressing issues of our time. I am a West Point graduate and decorated combat veteran. My character has been tested and proven on the battlefield. I have a history of solving big problems, in some of the toughest circumstances all over the world, both in the military and corporate sectors. I have the greatest breadth of experience of any candidate in this race. Folks, we are in a time of great crisis, and this is a time where we need warriors, men, and women of action, who can address some of the greatest problems of our time without being corrupted by the pervasive and insidious influences of the swamp. I am the only candidate in this race who can both win the General election against our Radical Left opponent, solve the problems in DC, and not become corrupted by the swamp. I will not compromise my principles. I will not lose myself in this endeavor. I will not lose my soul for this. What I will do is honor my oath to uphold the US Constitution without fail as I strive tirelessly to serve you, the people of Colorado and this great nation. Send me to Washington so I may serve you.

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---

## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

| There’s so much at stake this November — issues like lowering the costs of prescription drugs and gas prices, fixing our supply chains and a women’s right to choose.

**But I want to hear from you! What are the issues that are concerning you the most? What is motivating you to get to the polls, volunteer or get involved this election cycle?**

It’s crucial for this campaign that I hear directly from grassroots activists about what is most on their minds!

**[Please take just a moment to share your thoughts, motivations and concerns.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45428955/345906683/-336687945?refcode=DK_EM_SV_3MO_20220517_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZTNkZTAwZi0xOGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Uav0mFjthe9C9xYG7NrX3ms3KKjhK963_uH2POyIhDA=&emci=e63de00f-18d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=ee3de00f-18d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=31479900)**
**[TAKE THE SURVEY](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45428956/345906684/-336687945?refcode=DK_EM_SV_3MO_20220517_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZTNkZTAwZi0xOGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Uav0mFjthe9C9xYG7NrX3ms3KKjhK963_uH2POyIhDA=&emci=e63de00f-18d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=ee3de00f-18d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=31479900)**
We’ve talked a lot about how this is the toughest race I’ve ever faced, but I want to put why that’s important into a broader context. Democrats control the House by a slim margin.

Just a handful of seats will make-or-break our majority this November — **and national pundits have made it clear that the path to victory runs straight through this congressional district.**

Elections matter. 2020 proved that more than ever before, and we can’t repeat past midterms that saw the president’s party losing control of Congress. This election is truly the most crucial of our lifetimes.

**That’s why I need to know what matters most to you. I know we ask a lot of our supporters, but it’s because we know you care about the direction our country is headed in. Share your thoughts now:**

**[https://go.dankildee.com/a/2022-spring-priorities](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45428957/345906685/-336687945?refcode=DK_EM_SV_3MO_20220517_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZTNkZTAwZi0xOGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Uav0mFjthe9C9xYG7NrX3ms3KKjhK963_uH2POyIhDA=&emci=e63de00f-18d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=ee3de00f-18d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=31479900)**

Together, we can fight for our democracy and the country we want to live in, but I need to hear from you to win.

Thank you for sharing your thoughts!

Dan

clean_body: Can you help us reach these voters? | | | Dear Team, This week, vote by mail ballots are on their way to voters all across the district. We absolutely need to win these likely voters and they could vote at any moment. We have been calling vote by mail ballot requesters on phone banks for the last 2 weeks, and the response has been incredibly positive! But we need to reach every voter before they vote, so we are going to do a blitz of distributed voter contact tomorrow and thursday. On the doors, on the phones, and in meet and greets across the district, when voters hear our message they are enthusiastically ready. Our only challenge is getting that message out to hundreds of thousands of voters who haven’t heard from anyone in Congress for years. We can do this, it just has to happen now. In Solidarity, Kina Collins | To give by check: Kina Collins for Congress 901 Lake Street, Unit 4093 Oak Park, IL 60301

body:
We’re looking for 50,000 people to add their names in support of the one idea with the broadest appeal among Democrats, Independents, and even Republicans:
#

Friends -
After a tragic weekend with a number of mass shootings, people all across the country are asking:
**When will Congress act to make our communities safer from gun violence?**
We’re looking for 50,000 people to add their names in support of the one idea with the broadest appeal among Democrats, Independents, and even Republicans:
Pass universal background checks.
It’s a small and simple action, but it speaks volumes about the size of the movement to change our gun laws.
[**Use this link to say you want Congress to pass universal background checks for gun purchases in the United States.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_unbc_petition/?source=em220517-1-15&t=1&akid=2019%2E3935704%2EL1lxaL)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_unbc_petition/?source=em220517-1-15&t=2&akid=2019%2E3935704%2EL1lxaL)**
We know the actions we can take to save lives.
And we know it starts with making sure people who should not be allowed to have guns aren’t able to buy them.
The only place this idea is controversial is Congress.
And that is why it is so important we are able to tell legislators that the intensity of the desire to change our gun laws is high.
Please:
[**Use this link to say you want Congress to pass universal background checks for gun purchases in the United States.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_unbc_petition/?source=em220517-1-15&t=3&akid=2019%2E3935704%2EL1lxaL)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_unbc_petition/?source=em220517-1-15&t=4&akid=2019%2E3935704%2EL1lxaL)**
Thank you,
Team Giffords

subject: We've come a long way
body:
I'm just getting started
To view this email as a web page, go [here.](https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=65eb2a728a4545babd926206b0f3bdfc005dc97335f64a88b733e00a295519e9895b9b30ae35dfe8f16f99e03bff7107df666aae9246ffd51be3ece5340511fcd1a99ce1403610e4b9606ae562a1e2a9)
---
| | | | | | | | [](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=e6349622539e4a66b531bc021ea2a7a93b5f7055345548e2034900f002b1b3080c833a3857902e4454e8458a35ddf4f15ff32e010bda82a4420a4a1d1c70a6b0)
---
When I was elected Governor in 2018, there were 263,000 more Democrats registered in the state of Florida than Republicans.

Flash forward to now, in 2022, as I write this to you. For the first time in Florida's history, Republicans outnumber the amount of registered Democrats - **and we will NEVER go back!**

This is a direct result of our _freedom-first leadership_ in the Sunshine State. Since day one, I have advocated for the protection of the God-given individual liberties enshrined in our Constitution. **_[Pledge your support for our freedom-first mission>>>](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=e6349622539e4a66e043f2b3667437bd8ec55c1fdf6e9c98b281c4fa55e10abf018435fbc6140864508e9ecdd3d9fa3ffaa7dfaad800fbb79e5574590686521d "Pledge your support for our freedom-first mission >>>")_**

I decided to run for Congress because of the same idea: what Obama and his cronies were doing was totally inconsistent with the founding of our country and our constitutional principles.

I could write pages worth of examples from the Obama era, and now the Biden administration, in which liberal elites in Washington acted in their own self-interest rather than for those whom they were elected to _represent_.

Perhaps the most apt recent example is _the entire year of 2020._

Today, millions of Americans look to Florida as freedom's vanguard because for the last two years, we have stood strong against the dishonest, left-wing media, Big Tech Oligarchs, and lockdown Democrats, keeping Florida open and free. **__[These are accomplishments I'm proud of, and I could use your help to keep going.](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=e6349622539e4a66f4c1a46e682f19716abf40bd4a7e40da3d4bb6f947f191fe8d6ee88f3ddf20f35406a70b2101b16b25fa5397b4934ff8ad7e2f5f7d78f6a8 "These are accomplishments I’m proud of, and I could use your help to keep going.") __**

**In Florida, we protect people 's right to work, their right to operate their business, and their right to send their kids to school - in-person! **

I remember the summer of 2020 distinctly, Florida stood virtually alone in refusing to shut down our schools. In fact, I remember how viciously _attacked_ I was for it.

But I was right in rejecting the demands of self-proclaimed "experts" who advocated measures that would harm our children. **_I will always put Floridians first_**. Today, our state, our economy, and our families are better for it and far ahead of lockdown states.

I was right. They were proven wrong. A fact the Biden administration simply cannot stand.

**My promise to you is this** : as long as I am Governor, _we will never let the state of Florida descend into a Faucian dystopia in which our freedoms are curtailed, children are harmed, and in which our lives are ruined_. We will lead so that others may follow. **__[Will you stand with us?](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=e6349622539e4a66b05e1ea4a0de00fa998ebb7295d94613c94cf480bba0959f6d656bffb8b15a274f1284d1143beeab5f0380614c65165db780dfae03f6ac4c "Will you stand with us?")__**

If we had bent a knee to the Biden administration and not stood strong against vaccine passports, sanctuary cities, and "catch and release" policies for illegal aliens, our Florida economy would not be booming like it is today.

In my next term, I will continue to stand strong against wokeness (_aka cultural Marxism_) as their cadres try to censor, intimidate, and cancel anyone who disagrees with Biden's radical agenda.

**In 2022, we will keep Florida free, grow our economy, lead the nation in job growth, keep kids in school, and reject unconstitutional mandates handed down by the federal government.__[Will you chip in now and stand with us?](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=e6349622539e4a66b87a60fa35bf1944f3c3c5491cf8de2abfe8034a1691e5f293c51e556e15d20dfe88cd26417c85855e18c1054c0a0a74fb87f4748e49b219 "Will you chip in now and stand with us?")__ **

As excited as I am to continue to serve Florida in this way, I cannot do it without your help and support.

**That 's why I am depending on a small number of carefully selected patriots who are willing and able to step up** and make an extraordinary difference as I prepare to take on each day's new challenges. **[STEP UP NOW>>>](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=e6349622539e4a66064d4b5b3e0d0f53ec3fb783256ee00b660cbd9d8262cfc4b19dcbc6d78b0808d59dde3acdee99c19cd9b5e84025dc17b6df95f05d9e507d "STEP UP NOW >>>")** I was a political outsider when I won my first campaign for Congress - _and I still consider myself one now._ **I 'm running for reelection because I love freedom and seek to protect it in Florida**. I've shown the liberal media I'm willing to fight for what I love and what I believe in. Together, we can win again and keep up the fight for America's future.

**_[Will you join me?](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=e6349622539e4a662f06277c8a5d64e18d73ed629d2dd2235bac3ffad8d683a6e12c1a928c55f380bde76d1612e5c7c84f544d1c29cd8e6553e1263db097ca60 "Will you join me?") _** Sincerely,
---
|
---
Ron DeSantis

In the Wisconsin Legislature, I worked to allow pipelines to run through Green Bay and rebuild the flow of gas in our country, as well as cutting taxes to offset the cost of outrageous fuel prices. It's time we send a message to the Biden Administration and the Democrats who support him: get out of the way of American energy independence! Thank you, Roger Roth | | Paid for by Roth for Wisconsin

Hi Team,

Rural Wisconsin is home. They’re not just voters; Republicans or Democrats. They’re neighbors, friends, people who understand what it’s like to grow up on a farm and work hard for what you have.

As I’ve been traveling around Wisconsin’s Third District, talking to voters, the biggest complaint I’ve gotten is that fancy Washington politicians talk too much and never listen. My mom used to tell me, “Brad, you were born with two ears and one mouth so listen twice as much as you speak.”

It’s high time Washington politicians start listening to rural voices. I also know what it feels like when the closest hospital used to be over an hour away, but it shut down due to budget cuts, so you’ve got to drive two-and-a-half hours instead.

body:
Our Senate majority is the last line of defense against the GOP’s plans.
#
I wanted to reach out personally, Peter, and **[ask for your help to defend our Senate majority.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45430387/345915885/918788469?refcode=dd_em_220517_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjUxYzJjYi0xZGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=o6RKoK6M9Lm6BNh1Lj3CJdrgMKLdIP41YOMsb_daOX8=) **But first, let me explain why:
I’m sure you didn’t miss the news about the urgent threat to _Roe v. Wade_ coming from the leaked Supreme Court draft opinion. But since then, Senate Republicans have doubled down in their commitment to undermine reproductive freedom across the country. Just last week, Mitch McConnell admitted that a "nationwide ban" on abortion was possible if the Senate GOP flip even **one seat**.
And while _Roe_ has dominated the news – and rightly so – Senate Republicans have continued to push for and propose legislation that will take us in the wrong direction.
Every day, people from Illinois make it clear that they’re counting on the Senate for help solving issues like the child care crisis, inflation, and more.
I’ve been laser-focused on working with my colleagues to draft and pass legislation that does exactly that.
But in the background, Senate Republicans have been unveiling their platform and making clear what they’ll do if they flip the Senate.
And I don’t say this lightly, but**it’s bad news**.
Our Senate majority is the last line of defense against the GOP’s plans, which include an archaic nationwide ban on abortions, tax hikes on the working class, climate change denialism, and more.
**[I’m sure I don’t need to tell you twice, but this is a make-or-break moment for Illinois and the country. Please, will you chip in $5, or whatever you can spare, to help us defend and expand our Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45430389/345915887/918788469?refcode=dd_em_220517_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjUxYzJjYi0xZGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=o6RKoK6M9Lm6BNh1Lj3CJdrgMKLdIP41YOMsb_daOX8=)**
My best,
Dick Durbin

name: Charles Booker
subject: We’re putting everything on the line today.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Today is the day we make history,
Peter.

Right now, Kentuckians are casting their final votes in the primary before
we officially become the Democratic nominee against Rand Paul.

I want you to know how proud I am of this movement. We’re building a
historic coalition from the hood to the holler to transform our politics
here in Kentucky and end this chapter of failed leadership under Rand
Paul. No one saw us coming, but there’s no doubt they see us now.

We’re putting everything on the line today. My team and I are already out
visiting the polls later and making sure everyone has what they need to
make their voice heard.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220517?refcode=em20220517-1933&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&refcode2=1933_346206_JCQZKo&akid=1933%2E346206%2EJCQZKo ]Can you chip in $5 to make sure our team has everything
they need to help voters today? It would mean a lot to me to feel your
support as we cross the finish line.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220517?refcode=em20220517-1933&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&refcode2=1933_346206_JCQZKo&akid=1933%2E346206%2EJCQZKo ]Chip in $5 →

Today is just the beginning of our work,
Peter.

If we want to replace Rand Paul, we need to build a widespread, diverse
grassroots coalition of voters. We need to organize in every corner of
Kentucky and center our conversations around the challenges too many
families in Kentucky face right now.

I’m ready to be that candidate. Mostly because I know firsthand what it’s
like to struggle. I’ve lived in poverty. I’ve been unhoused. I’ve lost
family members to gun violence. I am still paying off my student loans.

That’s why this campaign is proud to advocate for the priorities of
working people. It’s clear seeing the growing momentum on the ground for
our campaign that Kentucky is hungry for this kind of meaningful change.
My story is the story of millions of Kentuckians who are sick and tired of
politicians who continue to ignore us.

I have a feeling we’re going to give Rand Paul the shock of his life later
today. But first, we have a job to do today and make sure every voter
makes their voice heard. We know that some folks are going to be waiting
in line for a while, so please know I appreciate you, and let us know if
you need anything.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220517?refcode=em20220517-1933&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&refcode2=1933_346206_JCQZKo&akid=1933%2E346206%2EJCQZKo ]If you’re not voting today or just want to show some extra support,
will you make a donation before the polls close? We want to spend as much
as we can today on helping voters get to the polls and make sure they have
what they need to safely cast their ballots.

I know that together, we have the power this election to replace Rand Paul
and make history here in Kentucky.

We’ll send over some updates later.

Thank you for everything,

Charles

clean_body: Share your thoughts by taking my quick poll >>> | = Peter, Since the pandemic began, you may have noticed delays to receiving your mail. The USPS has had to slow down delivery on first class-mail, which can be everything from important bills to prescription drugs. These delays are a direct consequence of significant funding issues and cost-cutting policies by Donald Trump’s appointed Postmaster General. I’d like to hear from you - do you support increased funding for the postal service? Let me know right away: Peter, the USPS is a critical public good, especially for those of us in rural communities who rely on the postal service to keep us connected and deliver everything from birthday cards to blood pressure meds to mail-in ballots. I value our postal system and its workers. They are public servants, and they go above and beyond to make sure our mail arrives safely. In Congress, I will support measures to ensure USPS has the resources it needs. I’ve spent my professional life in public service in the Army and CIA, too, so I know that it’s not just a job - it’s a calling. USPS deserves to have the support and resources it needs to fulfill its essential mission - cutting costs by cutting corners is frankly unacceptable. If you agree, make sure you let me know by taking our poll now. | ONE-QUESTION POLL: Do you support increased funding for the U.S. Postal Service? | ** | ---|--- Thank you for sharing your thoughts on USPS with me, Deb | Deb Baldus McGrath is an Army Veteran, former CIA officer, and mother of three running for Congress in WI-03. She’s fighting for affordable health care, good-paying jobs, and common prosperity. Deb served our country for over four decades from all over the world. body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
[Unsubscribe](http://links.iterable.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=7a1877a48f604bca84f156f0b5513982&_s=be1a31eaba834559afc607826df8f0c8&_t=lzwcVcoGT5OjYHhbm5F0eSAnS_Nm-l4PCdX1el3pQ2032Gmcn-tQrEOYffxA-V66rt6PlBUO_xXvDbB_WpraE4lmpOH2bYLdctVp-9rwRX2FvPFXQ3hLM7h7lsQOjw5BUOYLIRwiGPC9HYUyLkad5cSRzNdvJ4PH_6AKHWsinV7beYC-8xSkjNHq0NZIqvB02_A9hWvqh8ZBL05vp9YJWdygMlU_Ac7NrPZm_fLuU_A%3D)
_Please see a message from our sponsor:_
---
[](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=7a1877a48f604bca84f156f0b5513982&_m=be1a31eaba834559afc607826df8f0c8&_e=zqelMPrkt449BnWipyg-BRIGo-T1d-LoLnkRzIW_D6K6Ptpg48eU3cZko2MEQz0F3_ShLusMVSVQhmUDW1rStxMAUdZieZ0vW9_uP3X2Pjv_kLIoM5px_tplcNGkTqaldlBgx2kv82dNsTpht5zhjOWsENf12SA5k2jSa5pYZQRuD4G3Yd9va1JBWWNv41CVbXYi0JsgXCgBq0X7T4zlVMysgIeyEbRruzT3_KxzQdYDocTqjP-Zdq4Oz7O-Nz_QjrwgVoBTBnZBpRHTIbgWERBuUJtdsWn7j9maOtaOGqsXIe7GPuIE0upVNVCgz7yxZEfpI2H1qTivp0gZNji-1MpE1yObnjaeicN3O17tquyy9_g9nI6f_MJToaZWY3lV_ZouuxiRvWkKrpa1rhByvA4uB-4l_qe3aJ_9tqLe3e_y8dmzwbyN4XSgd_xEXeKTTvuSNsMvXfzfWuJ1_i51Kw%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.**
By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.
You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below:
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=7a1877a48f604bca84f156f0b5513982&_m=be1a31eaba834559afc607826df8f0c8&_e=zqelMPrkt449BnWipyg-BRIGo-T1d-LoLnkRzIW_D6K6Ptpg48eU3cZko2MEQz0F3_ShLusMVSVQhmUDW1rStxMAUdZieZ0vW9_uP3X2Pjv_kLIoM5px_tplcNGkTqaldlBgx2kv82dNsTpht5zhjOWsENf12SA5k2jSa5pYZQRuD4G3Yd9va1JBWWNv41CVbXYi0JsgXCgBq0X7T4zlVMysgIeyEbRruzT3_KxzQdYDocTqjP-Zdq4Oz7O-Nz_QwrsAkYsjgecKbUCs-NVvbtty3FK1quFul7CZoQBSFZ-cTM7r1Pw95hXx6O3c3vxeJ8P1SqfjzjStf6iFNwqNLi8dJZ5NZgUKftE49Ya52lU4eH2GAguQgBE_914H2A_wqNXkL6m757GRhqCp4KisiXu5EWVV9S1CEi9MkhLm0LzesMuokXOWTDZbteHk2nvwQW_66qdDJc-i8CYpOi5JXg%3D%3D)**
For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.
**But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.**
This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.
Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states.
These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and

**And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.**

body:
We need your help to restore a pro-life majority to Congress and ensure that the lives on innocent babies in the womb are ALWAYS protected ... | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ddc8427aea15/endorsed-by-susan-b-anthony-list?e=fc83fb200d)

|
,

I'm excited to announce that today we received the endorsement of Susan B. Anthony List!

---
|
---
|
Susan B. Anthony list is one of the most significant national groups dedicated to preserving the lives of unborn children in the womb. As a founding board member of a crisis pregnancy center and a life-long advocate for the lives of unborn babies, I am honored to have received this endorsement.

In Congress, I will always always carry the banner of the pro-life cause. I have no problem debating the Democrats head on when it comes to the issue of abortion; and I am ready to spearhead a new, pro-life majority in Congress that will protect the lives of unborn babies.

The Democrats are already attacking me for it:

---
|
---
|
The Democrats know that I'm the one who will be able to defeat Jennifer Wexton this November AND stick to my pro-life principles while doing it.

I'm ready for a change in our nation's leadership, and I'm ready for a majority that defends innocent babies in the womb.

With recent efforts from Democrats in Washington to pass legislation codifying abortion rights, it has never been more important to elect pro-life representatives.

**_Can I count on your support to help me defeat Jennifer Wexton and go to Congress to protect the unborn?_**

[Please consider making](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=71e2764db3&e=fc83fb200d)[ a contribution of $100, $50, $25, or even just $10 ](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=60f6183d60&e=fc83fb200d)[to help us defeat Wexton and end the massacre of innocent human life in the womb.](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=d7ab27f820&e=fc83fb200d)

| | **_FIND YOUR MAY 21ST VOTING LOCATION_**
On May 21st, voting will be open from 9am-4pm. Your voting location is determined by where you live, and you will not be allowed to vote anywhere other than your designated voting location. You can find a full list of voting locations at [www.JeanineLawson.com/Voting](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=bf0658458e&e=fc83fb200d)

For additional help determining your voting location, please call 571-484-4425 or email [info@jeaninelawson.com](mailto:info@jeaninelawson.com) and we can help you determine where to vote.

**Prince William County: **your voting location will be determined by your magisterial district.

If you live in **Brentsville District represented by Supervisor Jeanine Lawson** , your voting location will be Gainesville Middle School located at 8001 Limestone Drive, Gainesville.

If you live in **Gainesville District represented by Supervisor Pete Candland**, your voting location will be Bull Run Middle School located at 6308 Catharpin Road, Gainesville.

If you live in **Coles District represented by Supervisor Yesli Vega or in Occoquan District**, your voting location will be Lake Jackson Fire Station located at 11310 Coles Drive, Manassas.

**Loudoun County: **Your voting location will be determined by your magisterial district _unless you live in Blue Ridge District represented by Supervisor Tony Buffington._

If you live in **Blue Ridge district** , your district is split between two voting locations. Find your precinct by visiting the [State Board of Elections website](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=8b0e164de9&e=fc83fb200d).
Blue Ridge precincts 301, 302, 303, 305, 308, 310, 311, and 315 vote at Loudoun Valley High School.
Blue Ridge precincts 307, 309, 312, 313, 314, 316, 318, 319, 320, 321, and 322 vote at Mercer Middle School.

If you live in **Catoctin, Leesburg, or portions of Blue Ridge** districts, your voting location will be Loudoun Valley High School located at 340 N. Maple Avenue, Purcellville.

If you live in **Algonkian, Ashburn, or Broad Run** districts, your voting location is Broad Run High School located at 21670 Ashburn Road, Ashburn.

If you live in **Sterling, Dulles, or portions of Blue Ridge **districts, your voting location is Mercer Middle School located at 42149 Greenstone Drive, Aldie.

**Fauquier County:** Your county-wide voting location will be Fauquier High School located at 705 Waterloo Road, Warrenton.

**Rappahannock County** : Your county-wide voting location will be Rappahannock County Elementary School located at 34 Schoolhouse Road, Washington.

**Fairfax County** : Your voting location for all voters in the 10th district will be the Clifton Town Hall located at 12641 Chapel Road, Clifton.

**Manassas City** : Your city-wide voting location will be Grace E. Metz Middle School located at 9950 Wellington Road, Manassas.

**Manassas Park City** : Your city-wide voting location will be the Manassas Park Community Center located at 99 Adams Street, Manassas Park.

If you have any questions, please call 571-484-4425 or email [info@jeaninelawson.com](mailto:info@jeaninelawson.com)and we can help you determine where to vote.

| Peter, **Today marks 68 years since the Supreme Court made the landmark decision Brown v. Board of Education and declared segregation in public schools unconstitutional. ** This was a monumental decision, but the promise of progress decided so many years ago has fallen short. Not only are our public schools in many places almost as segregated as they were before Brown, but far-right elected officials and appointed judges are continuing to perpetuate the legacy of systemic racism in education. **As governor, I’m committed to making Maryland a national leader in combating modern-day segregation and promoting equity in every classroom. I’m hoping I can depend on you to support my efforts, Peter:_[Will you join me in calling for statewide action to fulfill the promise of equal education for all?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45431709/345921514/621977774?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MzFiNmE1OS0yNGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WPzxHQkt292TTNxjH_NlK6KyYabA7HV79lDmlgqu9FM=&emci=d0c8ba38-ebd5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=631b6a59-24d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=24635484)_** | | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45431710/345921518/621977774?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MzFiNmE1OS0yNGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WPzxHQkt292TTNxjH_NlK6KyYabA7HV79lDmlgqu9FM=&emci=d0c8ba38-ebd5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=631b6a59-24d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=24635484)

When I served as President Obama’s Secretary of Education, I worked to change the painful reality that our education systems fail to ensure equitable opportunities for so many of our Black and brown students. And while I’m very proud of the work our administration did to close opportunity gaps, promote diversity in our schools, and expand Pell Grant access, I know we still have much more to do.
**Every child deserves an equal chance for education and opportunity, no matter their race, zip code, or background. A King-Siri administration will work tirelessly to make that the reality for all Maryland students and families. **
We have a real opportunity to make a difference for kids across Maryland and set a national example of commitment to our shared values of equity and inclusion. _**[Please, stand in support of delivering on the promise of equal education for all by adding your name to our petition today >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45431712/345921519/621977774?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MzFiNmE1OS0yNGQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WPzxHQkt292TTNxjH_NlK6KyYabA7HV79lDmlgqu9FM=&emci=d0c8ba38-ebd5-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=631b6a59-24d6-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=24635484)**_

Last night, at the Kepler Theater at Hagerstown Community College, the five remaining candidates (Bob Poissonnier bizarrely dropped out in his closing remarks) for the GOP nomination in Maryland's 6th district went head-to-head in the first debate of the primary. The candidates demonstrated a clear grasp of the issues important to everyday Marylanders. Each made their case as the best candidate to take on the woke, open border multi-millionaire "Total Whiner" David Trone in November.

But, in the end, Dr. Mariela Roca emerged as the clear winner to take on the woke liberals, radical Democrats and leftist scum in Washington. No one matched her passionate delivery and fighting spirit. The enthusiastic audience responded with the loudest applause each time Mariela spoke.

Mariela showed she's the best candidate to take the FIGHT to David Trone and the woke liberals. She stated repeatedly that, as a combat vet who faced down the Taliban on a daily basis at the Bagram Detainment Facility in Afghanistan, the Democrats, lying media and leftist mob will not intimidate or scare her in the general election.

From growing up in poverty in Puerto Rico, to serving her country in combat in Afghanistan, to earning three degrees while working full time and raising two kids and now running for Congress as a strong, America-First conservative, there's no story better than Mariela's. There's no one the Democrats will fear more in the general --- not even close. Many of her opponents' supporters even concede this.

Last night, Mariela's American dream-come-true story and relentless, fighting spirit showed through and won over the audience. She's the best choice in district 6 to take on the woke multimillionaire David Trone, failing Joe Biden and the disastrous Democrats and their radical agendas on the border, crime, the economy and in our schools.

Hey, Peter, it's Daniel, Abby's husband. I'm emailing you to ask if you could make a contribution before the most important FEC fundraising deadline that Abby has ever faced. Before I do that, I hope you'll allow me to explain why your donation is so critical.
Abby's opponent, Sen. Chuck Grassley (R-IA), has _never_ been this vulnerable. He's facing his highest disapproval rating in nearly two decades, and only 27% of likely Iowa voters reported wanting to reelect him! I've lived in Iowa my whole life, and I've never seen anything quite like the energy on the ground right now. This moment is a truly incredible opportunity for Democrats – Abby in particular.
This isn't just about winning a critical seat for Democrats, although Abby has plenty of experience with that as the youngest woman to flip a House seat from red to blue. This is also about getting rid of a senator who has actively fought against progress for working Iowans; a senator who's worked to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ and control women's health care decisions; a senator who defended Donald Trump's attempts to overthrow the election and then stood on stage with him in Des Moines to accept his endorsement.
Sen. Grassley is wrong for Iowa, and his leadership has failed us. **With Abby in the Senate, working families would have a true champion in Washington. It's what they need; it's what they deserve – and, come November, it's what they're going to choose.**
Abby is determined to fight for us day in and day out, but defeating Sen. Grassley is going to take major resources, which is why I have to ask: With Abby's FEC reporting deadline approaching TOMORROW, can you chip in a contribution of $5 to ensure we have the resources defeat Sen. Grassley? We just need to raise $14,927 to hit tomorrow's goal, and your contribution could put us over the top. – Daniel

Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: "When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?" This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a "Great Reset" of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ -Hillsdale College's digest of liberty-author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'-a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below." Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for-and opposition to-socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://trk.readactnews.-iR_cTm0P1g04FJKM5Uw)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left's "long march through the institutions"-including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory-which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race-are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale's work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That's why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, "Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy." If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://trk.readactnews.-Fw)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember-**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. ArnnPresident, Hillsdale CollegePursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Let’s Take America Back |

| | Friend,

We are _one week away from the primary election_ in Georgia.

This is **the most important midterm election** of our lifetimes. The Radical Left, led by Joe Biden, Kamala Harris, and Nancy Pelosi are purposely _destroying our country._

Joe Biden said he would _transform America, and that is one promise that he has kept_. He transformed a booming economy into a shrinking economy. He transformed a secure southern border into a full blown invasion. He transformed peace through strength into humiliation and war. [I need you to CHIP IN and JOIN my team today so we can take our country back!](https://davidcurryforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=852ebb75cc52ccc1113c21207&id=0d457d2166&e=598f6aa24c) **This path is not sustainable.**

We need**BOLD Conservative** leaders to step up and take our country back!

_I am that leader._ I am the only life-long conservative in this race and I will bring our Georgia values to Congress.

On Election Day, reclaim your country by _voting for David Curry_. I will fight for you every single day and together we will restore the American Dream. [](https://davidcurryforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=852ebb75cc52ccc1113c21207&id=6e3bed6de5&e=598f6aa24c) [](https://davidcurryforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=852ebb75cc52ccc1113c21207&id=e4b04c38e2&e=598f6aa24c) [](https://davidcurryforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=852ebb75cc52ccc1113c21207&id=0cdf58dcf3&e=598f6aa24c) [](https://davidcurryforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=852ebb75cc52ccc1113c21207&id=81d48010b7&e=598f6aa24c) Thank you,

David Curry

We are the generation that will end gun violence. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/082173319e65/announcing-the-root-causes-of-gun-violence-act?e=339f142c50)

# The Root Causes of Gun Violence Act
---
| [ ](https://cole2022.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7401cdbeeb0470d9b36be09ed&id=920907a436&e=339f142c50)
---
| **This country has an epidemic of violence, and all we do is react to it. It's time we change how we deal with gun violence by preventing it from happening. **The [Root Causes of Gun Violence Act](https://cole2022.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7401cdbeeb0470d9b36be09ed&id=91f1214c41&e=339f142c50) is going to do that, and more.

This weekend, a white supremacist killed 10 people. A shooting in Millennium Park killed a teen. My friends and I were in Milwaukee and missed a mass shooting by minutes. This is an epidemic, and this is why I've been talking about the issue for so long.

I had my "end gun violence" sign when I was at the Super Bowl, and was almost arrested because of it. I have been advocating for creating real change for a long time, and now that summer is around the corner, we are feeling the pressure even more.

That's why I have been working on the Root Causes of Gun Violence Act. As a Congressman, this is my #1 issue. There is nothing more important to me. We will be the generation that ends gun violence because we are so damn tired of losing our family and friends.

**Share your story through our campaign website[here](https://cole2022.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7401cdbeeb0470d9b36be09ed&id=e2d150f5da&e=339f142c50).**

**My hope is that this legislation paves the way for us to rethink crime prevention, and create community-involved solutions on a national scale.**

Yours in service,
Jahmal

---

---
|
---
**TO: SOUTH CAROLINA REPUBLICANS** Fellow Republicans, our American source of identity can be found in a multiplicity of separate and distinct historical documents.

1\. The Declaration of Independence

2\. The Federalist Papers

3\. The Mayflower Compact

4\. The Fundamental Orders of Connecticut

5\. The First State Constitutions (specifically South Carolina)

6\. Common Sense written by Thomas Paine

7\. The Constitution of the United States of America

8\. Washington's Farewell Address

9\. Lincoln's Gettysburg Address

10\. Religion and the Constitution - Supreme Court Decision-Making by McConnell, Garvey, and Berg

And of course, the Bible is the most important one of them all!

As Americans, when we learn to live, breath, and act out the frameworks provided, we become a united AMERICA, with a singular focus to protect and defend our sacred CHARTER , the Constitution of the United States of America.

God bless the citizens of District 4.

VOTE Mike LAPIERRE for Congress
SC District 4 - Greenville and Spartanburg Counties

I LIKE MIKE
God bless the beautiful state of SOUTH CAROLINA!
|

subject: ICYMI: Manchin is telling voters to support Republicans

body:

Look, I know this is a tough time for those of us who care about the rights and freedoms we _should be_ guaranteed as Americans. From our own bodies to our communities to our elections, it seems like _everything_ is under attack.

Some people will say it’s too much, and tune out completely. Others will let their grief and anger fuel them toward taking action.

I have a feeling you’re in the second group, friend.

**If that’s you – if you haven’t given up –** [_I’m asking you to donate to the NDRC today._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45433913/345931246/1731801576?amount=20&refcode=20220517.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjMzMjVmYmI5LTJjZDYtZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4YzMyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ho-xbNH0clMWFlb4hopV5wRdTlSzY12CbFA6ztnZtFs=)

**Here’s why:**

The right to vote and to have one’s vote count equally is the right that underlies all others. Without a functioning, healthy democracy, we don’t have the tools to protect the rights and freedoms we hold dear.

So when Republicans try to take away our right to vote fairly and equitably – as they continue to do through gerrymandering and voter suppression – we _must_ fight back.

Which brings me to a choice we all have to make between keeping up the fight, and hoping it’s enough that someone else does it.
