body:
#

Friends --
We need to be absolutely clear: Democrats must expand the majority in November if we’re going to deliver meaningful progress for people, democracy and our planet.
If we don’t, Senate Republicans have said they plan to raise taxes on our families, ban abortion even in cases of rape and incest, gut Social Security and Medicare, and make more attacks on our rights and progress.
Republicans know they cannot win running on such a harmful and unpopular agenda, and the recent polling in this race shows our general election starts in a statistical tie no matter which Republican wins tonight.
So Republicans’ plan is clear: super PACs have already booked over $33 million in just TV ads to attack Cheri and try to buy this seat. That’s on top of the $14 million Club for Growth has already spent.
Between Mitch McConnell’s super PAC, Senate Leadership Fund, and the NRSC, McConnell’s allies are dumping more dark money into North Carolina than any other Senate race besides Georgia. It’s a clear sign that even Republicans are acknowledging this race is extremely close.
[**If you’re ready to beat them and expand our majority, make a $3 donation to send Cheri Beasley to the U.S. Senate.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-may22?refcode=em220517-2-mat1&refcode2=895.357359.gEgmC9&t=1&akid=895%2E357359%2EgEgmC9)
There’s no time to waste. The general election starts tomorrow, and the NRSC is already on the air with a sloppy smear attack distorting Cheri’s record of serving North Carolina and upholding the rule of law.
-- Team Beasley

clean_body: Why I’m running this campaign. | | | Peter, Everything we’ve worked for comes down to this final week. I’m running to fight for Medicare for All, good-paying union jobs and to unseat the last anti-choice Democrat in the House. Cuellar has $1.4 million in the bank and has the support of several right-wing Super PACs that are writing big checks to support his campaign. But, our grassroots movement is more powerful — especially if we each dig deep and do everything we can this final week. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: I know that we can win this runoff. I have been talking to folks from across the district and people are ready for change. This campaign is about much more than defeating Cuellar. It’s about sending representation to Congress that will fight tooth and nail for working people, for immigrant communities, for all of my neighbors in South Texas who have been ignored, neglected, and disenfranchised. Despite everything stacked against us, we defied expectations by barely losing our primary in 2020. But it was just the beginning. Together, this time, we are going to prove that a big grassroots movement can take on the machine and win. But, I can’t do it without you, so please help us out in the final week of this runoff. #
Hey. It's Morris, Erica Smith's campaign manager.
I’m reaching out one last time because the polls close in just a few hours, and we need your help to close the gap on our final $60,000 fundraising goal. [**Can you rush a $5 donation right now?**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/57322?refcode=em20220517-1206&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1206%2E3698%2EQCBdsO)
**Reaching this goal is critical because Republican-aligned PACs poured over $2 million into this race to bankroll false attacks and misinformation about Erica, and this election could come down to a handful of votes.**
If we reach this goal, we can fully fund our last round of ads, text messages, and phone calls to get out as many votes as possible for Erica.
**If not, we risk sending an anti-choice Democrat — who’s voted with Republicans to restrict abortion access and attack voting rights — to Congress.**
Everything we’ve been working on will come down to what we do in these next few hours. So please, before the polls close:**[Can you chip in $5 or whatever you can? It would mean the world to Erica and our team if you helped us out one last time.](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/57322?refcode=em20220517-1206&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=1206%2E3698%2EQCBdsO)**
**[Donate $5](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/57322?refcode=em20220517-1206&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1206%2E3698%2EQCBdsO)**
I’m so proud of the team we’ve built. We haven’t taken a cent from corporate PACs or the fossil fuel industry.
With donations of $3, $15, and $50, we’ve defied the odds and built a people-powered movement for progressive change in Eastern North Carolina.
Thank you so much for everything you’ve done to support Erica and our campaign.
Now, let’s do this!
Morris Katz
Campaign Manager
Erica Smith for Congress

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-emails?refcode=em20220517-1206-footer&t=22&refcode2=1206_3698_QCBdsO&akid=1206%2E3698%2EQCBdsO)**

Friend: It's important for me to share my story with you about why I'm running and why this campaign means so much to me. I hope you'll give it a read.
**Back when I was a social worker, I met a young boy who was being seriously neglected at home.** He needed immediate support – but I was told it would be weeks before he could be evaluated. I didn't think he would make it until then, so I went around the red tape and got him the help he needed. I was reprimanded, but that's what it took to save his life.

I remember being so angry that the system designed to help children like him had totally failed him. **That's when I heard that the Orlando Police Department was recruiting, and I took a call to protect and serve my community, to help people like that young boy.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45436488/345941657/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3199-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMTdkMjE1MC0zOWQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WcEJOtxV2fCGbNUQGwE7rBHhRqU902ZLdOSDv78-Gis=)
Fast-forward 27 years: I was Orlando's first woman chief of police and worked tirelessly so children like that young boy I'd met as a social worker didn't have to live in fear of playing in the streets. In my last days as chief, Mayor Buddy Dyer sat me down for a chat:
**"You have to run for Congress," he told me.**

Me? A politician? I never thought of myself that way. I even laughed.
But, as I let the idea sink in, I thought about that young boy I helped as a social worker – we were still in touch three decades later. I knew he wasn’t the only one who had to overcome hardship in his childhood: 1 in 7 kids in the U.S. lives in poverty. If I could do something to help kids like him, wouldn’t it be wrong to pass up the opportunity?

That’s when I realized that I needed to run for office to help as many children and working families as I could – so that in the next generation, more children from Florida could grow up with an incredible story of opportunity like mine. Ever since then, I’ve never stopped fighting toward that goal.
**[I'll never tire of an opportunity to do good and to serve the most vulnerable members of my community, and I'm asking you to do the same. Pitch in a contribution of $5 or more now to help send me to the Senate and continue my work of building a better future for our children.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45436489/345941658/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3199-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMTdkMjE1MC0zOWQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WcEJOtxV2fCGbNUQGwE7rBHhRqU902ZLdOSDv78-Gis=)**
Not a day goes by that I don't think about that child – or all of the working families who are counting on leaders like me to help them get through dark times. To thrive and not just survive.
**For me, that's what this is all about – and it's why I believe the Senate is where I can do the most good. If I win this race, Democrats can expand our Senate majority. We'll be able to extend the enhanced Child Tax Credit that's cut child poverty by more than 40%. We'll protect children from gun violence. And we'll help families keep food on the table by making groceries and gas more affordable.**
[**That's the long and short of why I'm in this race, friend. If you're ready to help me build a better future, will you donate to my campaign today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45436490/345941659/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3199-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMTdkMjE1MC0zOWQ2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WcEJOtxV2fCGbNUQGwE7rBHhRqU902ZLdOSDv78-Gis=)

clean_body: more children from Florida can grow up with an incredible story of opportunity like mine | | | Friend: It's important for me to share my story with you about why I'm running and why this campaign means so much to me. I hope you'll give it a read. Back when I was a social worker, I met a young boy who was being seriously neglected at home. He needed immediate support – but I was told it would be weeks before he could be evaluated. I didn't think he would make it until then, so I went around the red tape and got him the help he needed. I was reprimanded, but that's what it took to save his life. I remember being so angry that the system designed to help children like him had totally failed him. That's when I heard that the Orlando Police Department was recruiting, and I took a call to protect and serve my community, to help people like that young boy. = Fast-forward 27 years: I was Orlando's first woman chief of police and worked tirelessly so children like that young boy I'd met as a social worker didn't have to live in fear of playing in the streets. In my last days as chief, Mayor Buddy Dyer sat me down for a chat: "You have to run for Congress," he told me. Me? A politician? I never thought of myself that way. I even laughed. But, as I let the idea sink in, I thought about that young boy I helped as a social worker – we were still in touch three decades later. I knew he wasn’t the only one who had to overcome hardship in his childhood: 1 in 7 kids in the U.S. lives in poverty. If I could do something to help kids like him, wouldn’t it be wrong to pass up the opportunity? That’s when I realized that I needed to run for office to help as many children and working families as I could – so that in the next generation, more children from Florida could grow up with an incredible story of opportunity like mine. Ever since then, I’ve never stopped fighting toward that goal. = Not a day goes by that I don't think about that child – or all of the working families who are counting on leaders like me to help them get through dark times. To thrive and not just survive. For me, that's what this is all about – and it's why I believe the Senate is where I can do the most good. If I win this race, Democrats can expand our Senate majority. We'll be able to extend the enhanced Child Tax Credit that's cut child poverty by more than 40%. We'll protect children from gun violence. And we'll help families keep food on the table by making groceries and gas more affordable. = Thanks for reading my story, Val Demings | | = | | Our grassroots campaign is off to a great start, but in a race as close as this one, I need your help to surge ahead and defend the Senate. Since the draft opinion on Roe v. Wade was leaked earlier this month, progressive politicians and the far-left activists they serve have launched an aggressive campaign to intimidate Supreme Court Justices.

body:
My stepfather was a union carpenter. I wouldn’t be here today without good union jobs and wages. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45436721/345942795/1820125544?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTFkODU1Ni0zY2Q2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ewt5GPYo3tcNuUAeTeJxVVCAyZ5kSeVMJ0VAm4jhdY8=) Team, **Our country is in the middle of a union revival.** From Amazon warehouses to manufacturing floors -- workers are sending a clear message to employers who treat workers poorly and barely pay a living wage. The American people are demanding change, and corporations are getting a much-needed wake-up call. I have firsthand experience of the impact unions can have. My stepfather was a union carpenter, and the good jobs and wages from his union helped me get where I am today. He used to say, _“where there are unions, all boats rise.”_ **I’m also honored to have been endorsed by several union leaders all across MT-01. Whether you're an ironworker or a firefighter, I’m committed to fighting to preserve the good jobs and wages in our district.** [**From Whitefish, MT to Washington D.C. -- it’s time to prioritize worker’s rights. If you’re with me, please chip in $3 or more to my campaign and send a pro-union candidate to Congress.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45436722/345942796/-10092236?refcode=em-5.17.22-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTFkODU1Ni0zY2Q2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ewt5GPYo3tcNuUAeTeJxVVCAyZ5kSeVMJ0VAm4jhdY8=) | **[Donate $3](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45436723/345942797/-10092236?refcode=em-5.17.22-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2OTFkODU1Ni0zY2Q2LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ewt5GPYo3tcNuUAeTeJxVVCAyZ5kSeVMJ0VAm4jhdY8=)**

Now more than ever, we need to help our working families get the good jobs and wages they need to thrive. I firmly stand with all union workers and their families.
[**We need to seize the moment of this union revival and send pro-union leaders to Congress. My stepfather was a union carpenter, and the good jobs and wages from his union helped me get where I am today. He used to say, “where there are unions, all boats rise.” I’m also honored to have been endorsed by several union leaders all across MT-01. | | | Neighbors:

It’s pretty clear that our member of Congress, Scott Fitzgerald, only listens to special interests and extremists.

Most of us agree on most things, but Scott’s party refuses to act. Whether it’s inflation, crime, healthcare, or climate change, Scott just votes no and points the finger.

I want to be a different kind of Congressman, who listens to concerns of families, especially those worried about losing their job or finding baby formula.

**Join me for a listening session in West Bend so I can hear about the challenges your family is facing. **
---
|
---
| **Tuesday, May 24th | 6:30 - 8:00PM **
West Bend Community Memorial Library
630 Poplar St
West Bend, WI 53095
**I’m running for Congress to bring common-sense leadership to Washington.** We need to help regular folks who are putting in an honest day’s work to get ahead, while ensuring that programs are available for those that need help to get back on their feet.

We need to focus on rebuilding the American middle class, so everyone gets a fair shake. All of us putting in our hours deserve to own a home, raise our families, meet basic expenses, and save for a rainy day.

**Scott Fitzgerald refuses to work for the middle class.** YOU deserve better.

**Join me in West Bend, at the library on Poplar Street, at 6:30 p.m. on Tuesday, May 24.**

See you there!
Mike

Well, that didn’t take long. I tweeted this [https://twitter.com/ericswalwell/status/1522671337403265030] the other day:

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ESCA-15-Email-May2022-FR-RoeVotingRights?refcode=E15563-20220516-RoeVotingRights-graphic-AbortionReproductiveRights-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=15 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ESCA-15-Email-May2022-FR-RoeVotingRights?refcode=E15563-20220516-RoeVotingRights-graphic-AbortionReproductiveRights-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=15]

While the right-wing outrage machine went into full-blown meltdown mode, one of their extremist leaders, Erick Erikson, proved me right by tweeting [https://twitter.com/EWErickson/status/1522603314327789568] :

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ESCA-15-Email-May2022-FR-RoeVotingRights?refcode=E15563-20220516-RoeVotingRights-graphic-AbortionReproductiveRights-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=15 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ESCA-15-Email-May2022-FR-RoeVotingRights?refcode=E15563-20220516-RoeVotingRights-graphic-AbortionReproductiveRights-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=15]

HOLD EXTREMISTS ACCOUNTABLE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ESCA-15-Email-May2022-FR-RoeVotingRights?refcode=E15563-20220516-RoeVotingRights-SB-AbortionReproductiveRights-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=15]

The 19th Amendment stipulates: “The right of citizens of the United States to vote shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any State on account of sex.”

In Michigan, a law from 1931 would make abortion a felony [https://www.npr.org/sections/health-shots/2022/05/07/1097205107/a-michigan-law-from-1931-would-make-abortion-a-felony-if-roe-falls] if Roe v. Wade falls. If other states follow this model, people who have abortions would be disenfranchised from voting after being designated “felons” for the “crime” of making their own health care decisions.

subject: Ukraine: a case study in bipartisanship
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220517&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220517&amount=28]
Friend,
The Ukrainian government has been very clear since Russia’s unprovoked attacks first began – they needed military aid, and fast. We listened, and last week, we were able to deliver.
Recently, I joined Representative Victoria Spartz (R-IN) in the Oval Office to witness our bill be signed into law: the Ukraine Democracy Defense Lend-Lease Act, which cuts through red tape to speed up the process of sending military equipment from America and other NATO allies to the Ukrainians. I introduced it back in February, shortly after Ukraine was first invaded – knowing that we needed to get assistance to the Ukrainian government as quickly as possible.
These types of lend-lease programs have a storied history in the United States. In World War II, the U.S. gave billions of dollars in aid – including military vehicles made in Michigan – to countries fighting the Nazi regime under a similar lend-lease program. It’s only fitting that the Ukraine Democracy Defense Lend-Lease Act was signed so close to Victory in Europe Day, which marks the date that the Nazis were ultimately defeated.
What’s more, this bill was passed with almost unanimous support – another example of the challenges we can solve when Democrats and Republicans put their differences aside. Hearing Rep. Spartz tell President Biden about her relatives back in Ukraine, and describe the Ukrainian people’s fighting spirit, was a special reminder that even though we may disagree about day-to-day policy issues, we are united as Americans and together can meet the greatest national security challenges we face on the world stage.

body:
This is your last chance to chip in before polls close.

Derek,
The polls will close in just a few hours and we cannot afford to take anything for granted.
If you haven’t voted yet, go cast your ballot NOW! **[You can find your voting location HERE.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/18244?t=1&akid=5883%2E434096%2ECdDVKQ)**

But when we win (knock on wood), we are going to need to step up our fundraising even more to defeat whichever self-funding multi-multi-millionaire we’re up against.

body:
I’m not here to fool you with any “the sky is falling!” language begging you to pitch in a donation. That’s just not how I’m choosing to run this campaign. Hey —

I’m not here to fool you with any “the sky is falling!” language begging you to pitch in a donation. That’s just not how I’m choosing to run this campaign.

But I am here to give you the hard truth: We fell just 2% short of our mid-FEC goal last night. It may not seem like much, but it’s enough to make a significant difference in a race as close as ours. Let me explain what I mean by this.

The reason my team and I have been pushing so hard to raise money from messages like this one is that we need to collect enough resources to extend our latest TV ad buy. For months, Ron Johnson has been flooding the airwaves, and we can’t let his message be the only one Wisconsin voters get to see. This race is just too important.

Look, some days are better than others, but when you average it all out, we’ve fallen short of our fundraising goal at the worst possible moment. (And honestly, we’ve just had one too many bad days.)

This is not the email I expected to write today, but it’s important that you know exactly where your money goes each time you decide to chip in to our campaign. A temporary lapse like this puts our budget in an even tighter spot — and right now, we’re not where we need to be to increase our TV spending. So, I’m hoping you can help.

name: Peter Welch
subject: re: Bridge Street
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
Bridge Street is where I got my introduction to how Vermonters get things done, and I’ll carry those lessons with me to the U.S. Senate.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=412%2E61531%2EhHD6U1)
Hello,
When I first moved to Vermont, I spent the majority of my days working as a lawyer on Bridge Street in White River Junction—and as much time as possible in the great outdoors.
A lot of my law school friends ended up on Wall Street or K Street. But I loved the work I was doing in the community—and my friends in New York and DC weren’t able to step right outside their homes and onto a trail for running, hiking, or mountain biking.
Through my time on Bridge Street, Vermont became my home, and it’s where I got to know the values of Vermonters: self-reliance, mutual support, and cooperation built on trust.
The Senate could use some more of Vermont’s values to help our state and our country move forward. That’s what I’ll work on if I have the honor of serving as Vermont’s next senator. But with Mitch McConnell targeting this race, it’s going to take everything we’ve got to keep this seat blue.
[**If you’re able to, please consider pitching into this key Senate race today. Anything you’re able to give will help continue growing this grassroots campaign.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/2709?t=3&akid=412%2E61531%2EhHD6U1)
_If you’ve saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_

---
| [$3](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/2709?t=17&amount=3&akid=412%2E61531%2EhHD6U1)
---
| [$15](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/2709?t=19&amount=15&akid=412%2E61531%2EhHD6U1)

---
| [$100](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/2709?t=13&amount=100&akid=412%2E61531%2EhHD6U1)
---
| [OTHER](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/2709?t=15&akid=412%2E61531%2EhHD6U1)
---

---
Bridge Street is where I got my introduction to how Vermonters get things done: by focusing on solutions, not who gets the credit. I’ve carried those lessons with me throughout my career, and they’ve been a major key to my success as a Congressman.
There’s so much we can accomplish for the people of Vermont and for working families nationwide: quality and affordable child care, paid family leave, a Green New Deal, Medicare for All, lower prescription drug costs, protecting the right to abortion, strengthening voting rights, and so much more. I’ll continue to work to deliver results on your behalf.
But if Mitch McConnell and the Senate Republicans regain the majority, they will continue their assault on individual rights and our democracy. We can’t let that happen, so we must work together to win this race.
[**This is a major moment for our campaign, with the national GOP ready to pour money into Vermont. Can you chip in $5 or anything you can spare to power this team to victory?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/2709?t=8&akid=412%2E61531%2EhHD6U1)
Thanks so much,
[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/2709?t=9&akid=412%2E61531%2EhHD6U1)
Peter

| | | I launched my Make Our Economy Great Again plan to combat inflation. It is crucial that we stop the disastrous policies of Maggie Hassan and President Biden that have only fanned the flames of high inflation before it’s too late. We need balanced spending, not overregulation. We need to do things the 603 way - not the DC way.

**_Check out my plan here:_**

---
---
| | | **_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

| Dear Friend,

Tina Ramirez, Founder and President of Hardwired Global, invites you to a fundraiser this Thursday, May 19th , to celebrate the launch of the Peaceful Garden Project education initiative.

Our special guest, supermodel-turned-super mogul, Kathy Ireland, will join Tina on stage to discuss the importance of teaching children the value of religious freedom and our most precious inalienable rights.

The Peaceful Garden Project, recently featured in Fox News, was inspired by Hardwired’s work in Iraq. At this event, you’ll hear more about the incredible work Hardwired has done to support teachers and communities around the world and now here in the U.S.

"The Peaceful Garden Project aims to counter divisive curricula with 'what we know works: a program based on inherent inalienable rights, human dignity, and respect for the freedom of conscience of every person.'"
\- Tina Ramirez via Fox News

Lewis Ginter Botanical Garden
Richmond, Virginia
Thursday, May 19th
5:00-7:00 PM

Hardwired Global

**About Hardwired Global** Hardwired Global is a non-profit organization focused on human rights and religious freedom education and training. This huge milestone was only possible because of the hard work and commitment of so many people who are ready for big CHANGE in our district. When I wrote the other day about the $1,740 filing fee I had to pay this past Monday, DOZENS of people pitched in what they could to help ensure my name was on the ballot. I can't tell you how much it means to have so many people ready to jump in and help when I need a boost. If you pitched in, thank you. For real. We have an incumbent who has ignored us for 11 years, and we're at risk of letting a Trump-endorsed extremist win this seat. The most recent polling we have seen shows JHB not making it to November. We CAN'T let a MAGA takeover of WA-03 happen. The next phase of this campaign is critical - and it's all about getting my name out there and connecting with the voters we need to #FlipWA03 from RED to BLUE. This Saturday, we're heading to the Hazel Dell Parade of Bands and we're asking people like you to join us. If you can make it, reply directly to this email and let us know your t-shirt size so we have some union-printed campaign swag ready for you. **But if you 'd rather pass on the parade, I understand. Like I said, before running for office myself, I used to donate to campaigns instead of signing up to volunteer whenever a candidate I believed in needed support.** **[If you can't volunteer, I'm humbly asking you to pitch in $32 now to sponsor a volunteer in the field on Saturday and ensure we have the resources to stay in the lead in this race and WIN in November.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zdG1fUgG8aFKTw4TdAFcV3OYIkIXLeXYGdiD76HGOclWZYG428h3SLdZNmun5o9X7k5gecMqAtUNG5_LyOtfyNYpRlIIwNujgqKOIyFdty607fwdB9IrHS43Sl8MlP1qOSHEdIHVfXFJkXS6y01_7-XzZipu3Uwe-qj5Ne4IMUOqsAP_DVtTr9vfguMM5uGTkjuIRqo7i885_mWcGIFYmiHCRpt6KlsgFlwoCx1oDQWS_u2MNnJFk7R3eW39-SK83b-gXU4g2tkACszDBNnd7nJFar9nx6obfiAGEu-24nIOTCJxjv6WWSyK8zF6cQ9FYr51J-aIl-npZwYQOfWd3BfvF46bMVmmdOxzDm0pRikw/3m4/fpowQPjPTEmRu6UGvg0LgA/h2/tNbeTMMhSf3A3cpwtkAierkgIwEcd68Sha_x4TFiuhU)** I appreciate any support you can show my campaign today. Our race was just called, and I’m honored to accept North Carolina Democrats’ nomination for U.S. Senate.
#

Friends --
Our race was just called, and I’m honored to accept North Carolina Democrats’ nomination for U.S. Senate.
This moment could not have happened without the support of tens of thousands of people like you. It’s humbling.
But the truth is, it is only going to get harder from here. There is a lot of work ahead of us to deliver real progress for our families -- on lower costs, climate change, voting rights and more. That starts with winning this race and expanding our Democratic majority in the Senate.
North Carolina’s open seat is our best chance to do that, but the Republican attack ads against me have already started.
